beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своих планах на выходные. Пригласите его в кино или парк.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I have some plans for this weekend. I want to go to the cinema on Saturday because there is a new comedy that looks very funny. Would you like to join me? If you don't like films, we can go to the park instead. Let me know what you prefer. I hope you can come and we will have a great time together.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, поблагодарите его за помощь с проектом. Предложите угостить его кофе.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Anna, I want to thank you for helping me with the project last week. Your advice was really useful and I appreciate it very much. Could I buy you a coffee as a small thank you? Let me know when you are free. I look forward to seeing you soon and having a nice chat.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, объясните, почему вы пропустили занятие. Пообещайте наверстать материал.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Mr. Smith, I am sorry that I missed your class yesterday. I was not feeling well and had to stay at home. I will catch up on the material and complete all the homework. Could you please tell me what we studied? Thank you for your understanding and I promise to be more careful in the future.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, расскажите о своих успехах в школе или на работе. Спросите, как у неё дела.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, I hope you are well. I wanted to tell you that I got a very good mark in my English test last week. My teacher said I am improving a lot. How are you? I miss you very much and hope to visit you soon. Please take care of yourself and write back when you have time.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, извинитесь за шум во время ремонта. Пообещайте закончить работы до вечера.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I am sorry for the noise coming from my apartment. I am doing some repairs in the kitchen. I will try to finish all the work by this evening. I hope it does not disturb you too much. Thank you for your patience and understanding. I really appreciate your kindness.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, попросите о раннем заезде. Укажите номер брони.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I have a booking for tomorrow. My reservation number is 12345. Could I please check in early at 12 PM instead of the usual time? I will arrive in the morning. I would be very grateful if you could help me with this request. Thank you for your assistance and I look forward to my stay.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, попросите выходной на следующей неделе. Объясните причину (личные дела).
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to ask for a day off next Friday. I have some personal errands that I need to take care of. I will make sure all my work is done before I leave. I hope you can approve my request. Thank you very much for your understanding and I will be back to work on Monday.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, поблагодарите за заказ. Предложите скидку на следующий заказ.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, thank you for your recent order. We appreciate your trust in our company. As a token of our gratitude, we would like to offer you a 10% discount on your next purchase. We hope to see you again soon. Please contact us if you have any questions. We value your business.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру по бизнесу, предложите встречу для обсуждения нового проекта.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to suggest a meeting next week to discuss our new project. I think we can make good progress together. Please let me know which day is convenient for you. I am flexible and can adjust my schedule. I look forward to our conversation and working with you on this exciting project.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своей новой работе. Опишите, чем вы занимаетесь.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I started a new job last week and I really like it. I work as a designer in a small company. The team is very friendly and the work is interesting. I am learning a lot every day. How are things with you? I hope we can meet soon and catch up properly. Let me know when you are free.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо тренеру, поблагодарите за тренировку. Спросите, как улучшить свои результаты.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear coach, thank you for the training session yesterday. I felt I made some progress. Could you give me some advice on how to improve my speed? I really want to get better results. I appreciate your help and guidance very much. See you at the next training and I will try my best.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо врачу, запишитесь на приём. Опишите свои симптомы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Doctor, I would like to schedule an appointment because I have a headache and a sore throat. These symptoms started two days ago. Could you please see me sometime this week? I am available in the mornings. Please let me know when you have a free slot. Thank you for your time.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своей поездке в другой город. Опишите, что вы там делали.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I went to London last weekend. I visited the Tower of London and saw Big Ben. The city is beautiful and full of history. I also tried some traditional English food. I wish you were there with me. We should plan a trip together sometime soon. It would be great to explore new places.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, предложите свою помощь с отчётом. Спросите, нужна ли дополнительная поддержка.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I see you are working on the annual report. I have some free time today. Can I help you with the data analysis? I know it can be a lot of work. Let me know if you need any assistance. I am happy to help you out with it. Just tell me what to do.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, поблагодарите за интересный урок. Спросите, какие книги порекомендуете по теме.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, thank you for the interesting lesson yesterday. I really enjoyed learning about the topic. Could you recommend some books or articles where I can read more about it? I would like to deepen my knowledge. I appreciate your help. Have a nice day and see you next class.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, пригласите её в гости на выходные. Опишите, что вы приготовите.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, would you like to come and visit us this weekend? I will cook your favourite pasta dish for dinner. We can also go to the park if the weather is nice. I miss you a lot and I would love to see you. Please let me know if you can come. I am really looking forward to it.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, попросите присмотреть за квартирой, пока вы в отпуске. Объясните, где оставляете ключи.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I am going on vacation next week. Could you please water my plants while I am away? I will leave the keys with the caretaker. I would be very grateful for your help. Thank you in advance. I hope to bring you a small gift from my trip to show my appreciation.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, поблагодарите за отличный сервис. Пообещайте приехать снова.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I had a wonderful stay at your hotel. The room was clean and the staff were very friendly. I really appreciated the excellent service. I will definitely come back again in the future. Thank you for making my stay so enjoyable. I will recommend your hotel to my friends and family.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, предложите свою идею по улучшению рабочего процесса. Опишите её кратко.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I have an idea to improve our workflow. We could use a shared calendar to track tasks. This would help everyone stay organised and reduce confusion. I would be happy to set it up. Let me know what you think. I believe it would make our work more efficient and save time for all of us.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, принесите извинения за задержку доставки. Объясните причину.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we apologize for the delay in your delivery. We had some issues with the shipping company. Your order will arrive by Friday. We are very sorry for any trouble this may have caused. Thank you for your patience and understanding. We value your business and hope to serve you better next time.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своём новом хобби (например, фотография). Предложите ему присоединиться.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I have started a new hobby – photography. I love taking pictures of nature and landscapes. Would you like to join me this weekend? We can go to the park and practice together. I think you would enjoy it. Let me know if you are interested. I can teach you some basic tips.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, поздравьте с днём рождения. Пожелайте ему успехов.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, happy birthday! I wish you all the best on your special day. I hope you have a wonderful celebration with your family and friends. May the coming year bring you success and happiness. Enjoy your day. I look forward to working with you in the future and sharing more happy moments together.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, попросите дополнительный материал для подготовки к экзамену.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, could you please give me some extra materials to prepare for the exam? I want to practice more at home. I am a bit nervous about the test. Your guidance would be very helpful. Thank you for your support. I will do my best to study hard and achieve a good result in the exam.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, поблагодарите за подарок. Опишите, как вы его используете.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, thank you so much for the beautiful scarf you sent me. I wear it every day because it is very warm and soft. It matches my winter coat perfectly. I think of you every time I put it on. I am very grateful for your kindness and love. I hope to see you soon.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, пригласите на небольшую вечеринку в честь новоселья. Сообщите дату и время.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I am having a housewarming party on Saturday at 6 PM. I would be delighted if you could come. There will be some food and music. It would be a great chance to get to know each other. I hope you can make it. Let me know if you are coming. I am looking forward to meeting you.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, пожалуйтесь на шум в соседнем номере. Попросите переселить вас.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I am having trouble sleeping because of noise from the next room. The people there are talking loudly. Could you please move me to another room? I would appreciate your help. I need to rest well. Thank you for your assistance. I hope you can resolve this issue quickly.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, поблагодарите за повышение. Опишите свои новые обязанности.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, thank you for the promotion. I am very excited about my new role. I will be leading the design team and managing client relationships. I will do my best to succeed in this position. I am grateful for this opportunity to grow with the company. I will work hard to meet your expectations.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру по бизнесу, уточните детали предстоящей встречи. Предложите провести её в вашем офисе.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, could we confirm the details of our meeting? I suggest we hold it at our office on Thursday at 10 AM. We have a meeting room available. Let me know if that works for you. I look forward to our discussion. Please confirm your availability so we can finalise the arrangements.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о книге, которую вы прочитали. Порекомендуйте её ему.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I just finished reading a fantastic book. It's a thriller with many surprises. The plot is very exciting and I could not put it down. I think you would really like it. You should read it too. I can lend you my copy if you want. Let me know. I am sure you will enjoy it as much as I did.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, спросите, может ли он подменить вас на дежурстве в пятницу.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, could you please cover my shift this Friday? I have a doctor's appointment that I cannot reschedule. I can return the favour next week. Let me know if it is possible. I would really appreciate your help. Thank you in advance for your kindness. I owe you one.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, спросите, когда будут известны результаты экзамена. Поблагодарите за преподавание.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, I would like to ask when the exam results will be available. I am very curious about my score. Thank you for your excellent teaching this semester. I really appreciated your lessons. I hope to continue learning with you in the future. Have a nice day and thank you for everything.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, расскажите о своих планах на каникулы. Пригласите её к себе.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, I have holidays next month. I would love to invite you to stay with me for a few days. We could go sightseeing and cook together. It would be lovely to spend some quality time with you. Please let me know if you can come. I am really looking forward to it and miss you a lot.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, спросите, не видел ли он вашу почту, которую вы ждёте. Объясните, что это важное письмо.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I am expecting an important letter from the bank. Have you seen it in the post box by mistake? It might have been delivered to your address. Please let me know if you have it. I would be very grateful. Thank you for your help. I hope it is not lost.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, продлите своё пребывание на один день. Спросите, есть ли свободные номера.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would like to extend my stay for one more day. Do you have a room available for tomorrow night? I am happy to stay in the same room or move to another one. Please let me know the cost. Thank you for your assistance. I hope it is possible.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, предложите провести собрание по видеосвязи, чтобы сэкономить время.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I suggest we have a video call for our next meeting instead of meeting in person. This would save us travel time and make it more convenient for everyone. I can set up the call. Let me know if you agree. I think it will be more efficient and easier for all team members.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, сообщите, что его заказ отправлен. Приложите трек-номер.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are happy to inform you that your order has been shipped. Your tracking number is 98765. You can track it on our website. We hope you enjoy your purchase. Thank you for choosing our company. Please contact us if you have any questions. We value your trust.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, поблагодарите за сотрудничество в прошедшем году. Пожелайте успехов в новом году.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, thank you for your cooperation this year. We have achieved a lot together. I wish you all the best for the new year. I hope we can continue our successful partnership in the future. Happy new year to you and your team. Let's make next year even better.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своём любимом фильме, который вы недавно посмотрели. Порекомендуйте его.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I watched a great film yesterday called 'The Lost City'. It is an adventure movie with a lot of action. The actors are very good and the story is fun. I think you would enjoy it too. You should definitely watch it. Let me know what you think if you see it. I am sure you will like it.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, спросите, может ли он помочь вам с презентацией. Скажите, что вы подготовите материал.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I need some help with the presentation for the board. Could you please review the slides? I will prepare all the materials and send them to you. Let me know if you have time. I would really appreciate your feedback. Thank you in advance for your support and expertise.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, извинитесь за опоздание на урок. Объясните причину (пробки).
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, I apologize for being late to class today. There was a lot of traffic on the road. I will try to leave earlier next time. I hope you understand. I am sorry for any disruption I caused. I will make sure to arrive on time in the future. Thank you for your patience.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, расскажите о своих новых занятиях (например, йога). Спросите, занимается ли она чем-то подобным.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, I started practicing yoga. It helps me relax and stay fit. Do you do any exercises? Maybe we could try it together when we meet. Take care and write back soon. I would love to hear about your activities too. I hope you are enjoying your hobbies.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, поблагодарите за то, что он полил ваши цветы в ваше отсутствие. Скажите, что вы очень признательны.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, thank you so much for watering my plants while I was away. They look healthy and beautiful. I really appreciate your kindness. I will bring you some cake as a small thank you. I am very grateful for your help. You are a wonderful neighbor.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, спросите, можно ли оставить багаж после выезда на несколько часов.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I am checking out tomorrow, but my flight is in the evening. Could I leave my luggage at the hotel for a few hours? I would be very grateful. I will come back to pick it up later. Thank you for your assistance. I appreciate your flexibility and understanding.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, отчитайтесь о выполнении важного задания. Скажите, что всё готово.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am happy to report that the important task is completed. Everything is ready for review. Please let me know if you need any changes. Thank you for your trust. I have double-checked all the details. I am confident that the work meets our quality standards.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, предложите ему оставить отзыв о ваших услугах. Напишите ссылку на форму.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we would love to hear your feedback about our services. Please leave a review on our website using this link: [link]. Your opinion is valuable to us. It helps us improve. Thank you for your time. We look forward to serving you again in the future.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, предложите совместный вебинар для клиентов. Опишите тему.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I suggest we organize a joint webinar for our clients. The topic could be 'Effective Communication in Business'. We can split the presentation. Let me know your thoughts. I think this would be very useful for our clients. Please let me know if you are interested.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своей новой машине. Пригласите его прокатиться.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I bought a new car! It's a red sedan. I'm very happy with it. Would you like to go for a drive this weekend? We can visit the countryside. I think you will like it. Let me know when you are free. I can pick you up. It will be fun.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, спросите, не хочет ли он пообедать вместе сегодня. Предложите итальянский ресторан.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, would you like to have lunch together today? There is a nice Italian restaurant near the office. I heard they have great pasta. Let me know if you are free. I am looking forward to it. We can discuss the project in a relaxed atmosphere.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, спросите, можно ли сдать задание на неделю позже. Объясните, что у вас много работы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, I have a lot of work this week. Could you please extend the deadline for the assignment by one week? I will do my best to submit it on time. Thank you for understanding. I really appreciate your flexibility. I will make sure to complete it as soon as possible.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, расскажите о своей поездке на море. Опишите, что вы там видели и делали.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, I went to the sea last week. The beach was beautiful and the water was warm. I swam a lot and relaxed on the sand. I wish you were there. I took many photos to show you. I will visit you soon and tell you all about it. I miss you.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, спросите, не мешает ли ему ваш телевизор по вечерам. Скажите, что вы готовы сделать тише.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I hope my TV is not disturbing you in the evenings. If it is, please let me know. I can turn it down. I want to be considerate. Thank you for your understanding. I appreciate your honesty. Please feel free to tell me if there is any problem.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, сообщите, что вам понравился номер и сервис. Оставьте комплимент.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I really enjoyed my stay. The room was spacious and clean. The service was excellent. Thank you for making my stay comfortable. I will definitely come back. I also appreciated the friendly staff. You have a great team.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, попросите разрешения на удалённую работу на один день. Объясните причину.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to request remote work for next Monday. I have a plumber coming to my apartment. I will be available online all day. Thank you for your understanding. I will make sure to complete all my tasks. Please let me know if you need any more details.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, подтвердите получение его заявки. Сообщите, что обработаете её в ближайшее время.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we confirm receipt of your order. We will process it shortly. You will receive a notification when it is shipped. Thank you for choosing us. We appreciate your business. Please contact us if you have any questions. We are happy to help.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, предложите обновить условия контракта. Объясните, что это выгодно для обеих сторон.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I suggest we update our contract terms. The new terms would be more beneficial for both of us. We can discuss this in detail during our next meeting. I am confident this will strengthen our partnership. Please let me know your thoughts. I look forward to your response.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своём новом проекте на работе. Спросите у него совета.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I have a new project at work. It is about launching a new product. I'm a bit nervous. Do you have any advice for me? I would appreciate your thoughts. You always give good suggestions. Let me know if you have some free time to chat.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, поздравьте с завершением сложного этапа работы. Пожелайте отдыха.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, congratulations on completing the difficult phase of the project! You did a great job. Now you deserve a good rest. Enjoy your weekend. I am really impressed by your hard work. Let's celebrate when we have time. You are a great team member.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, спросите, есть ли возможность дополнительных занятий для улучшения языка.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, I would like to improve my English. Do you offer any extra classes or private lessons? I am very motivated to learn more. Thank you. I would be grateful for any extra help. Please let me know the details. I am willing to adjust my schedule.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, расскажите о том, как вы научились печь пирог. Поделитесь рецептом.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, I learned to bake an apple pie! It turned out well. The recipe is simple: flour, apples, sugar, and butter. I will make it for you when we meet. I hope you like it. I am very proud of myself. I will write down the full recipe for you.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, спросите, может ли он одолжить вам книгу, которую вы видели у него. Объясните, что она нужна для работы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I saw you have a book about gardening. Could I borrow it for a few days? I need it for my project. I will return it quickly. Thank you. I promise to take good care of it. Please let me know if that is okay.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, попросите организовать трансфер до аэропорта. Укажите время и дату.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I need a transfer to the airport on Saturday at 7 AM. Could you please arrange it for me? I would appreciate it. Thank you. Please let me know the cost. I will be ready at the reception. I look forward to your confirmation.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, поблагодарите за предоставленный отпуск. Сообщите, что вы готовы приступить к работе.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, thank you for the vacation. I had a great rest. I am ready to start work again. Please let me know if there are any urgent tasks. I am fully recharged. I look forward to new challenges. Thank you for your support.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, напомните о предстоящей встрече. Подтвердите время и место.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, this is a reminder of our meeting scheduled for tomorrow at 2 PM at our office. Please let me know if you need any directions. See you there. I look forward to our discussion. If you have any questions, please contact me.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, сообщите об изменении в расписании мероприятия. Перенесите на неделю позже.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, we have to change the schedule for the upcoming event. We will postpone it by one week. New date is July 20. I hope it still works for you. Apologies for any inconvenience. Please confirm if you can make it. We appreciate your flexibility.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своей поездке в горы. Опишите природу и впечатления.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I went to the mountains last weekend. The view was breathtaking. I hiked a lot and enjoyed the fresh air. I felt so peaceful. I recommend you visit too. The nature there is amazing. I took lots of photos. I will show you when we meet.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, попросите его прислать отчёт, который он готовил. Скажите, что он нужен для презентации.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, could you please send me the report you prepared? I need it for the presentation tomorrow. I will add it to the slides. Thanks for your help. I appreciate your prompt response. Please send it as soon as possible. Thank you in advance.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, поблагодарите за высокий балл на экзамене. Скажите, что вы приложили много усилий.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, thank you for my exam grade. I am very happy with the result. I worked hard and your lessons helped me a lot. I appreciate your support. I will continue to study hard. I am grateful for your guidance. You are a great teacher.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, расскажите о своём новом питомце (кошке или собаке). Опишите его внешность и характер.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, I adopted a kitten. She is black and white, very playful. Her name is Mila. She loves to chase balls. I will send you photos soon. She is very cute and friendly. I think you would like her. I hope you can meet her one day.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, спросите, может ли он починить вашу дверь (он умеет). Предложите заплатить.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I have a problem with my front door. It doesn't close properly. I know you are good at repairs. Could you please take a look? I can pay you for your time. I would really appreciate your help. Please let me know if you are available.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, спросите, есть ли в отеле тренажёрный зал. Уточните часы работы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, does your hotel have a gym? If yes, what are the opening hours? I would like to exercise during my stay. Thank you for the information. I appreciate your quick response. Please let me know the details. I look forward to using the facilities.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, предложите новый формат отчётов, который сэкономит время. Опишите его кратко.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I suggest we change the format of our weekly reports. We could use a simple checklist instead of long paragraphs. It would save time for everyone. Let me know what you think. I can prepare a sample. I believe this would increase our efficiency.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, спросите, удовлетворён ли он качеством товара. Если нет, предложите замену.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we hope you are satisfied with the product. If you have any issues, please let us know. We can offer a replacement or refund. Your satisfaction is our priority. We value your feedback. Please contact us if there is any problem. We are here to help.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, спросите, не хочет ли он посетить отраслевую выставку вместе. Предложите встретиться там.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, there is a trade exhibition next month. Would you like to go together? We could also invite potential clients. Let me know if you are interested. It would be a great opportunity to network. I think it would be beneficial for both of us.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своей неудаче (например, проваленный экзамен). Попросите поддержки.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I failed my driving test. I feel very disappointed. I need some encouragement. Can we meet and talk? I think I just need to practice more. Thanks for listening. Your support means a lot to me. I will try again next month.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, напомните о дедлайне по проекту. Попросите прислать свою часть работы.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, just a reminder that the project deadline is Friday. Could you please send me your part by Thursday? I need to compile everything. Let me know if you need help. Thank you for your cooperation. I appreciate your timely response.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, спросите, можно ли использовать дополнительные материалы на экзамене. Уточните правила.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, I would like to know if we are allowed to use a dictionary during the exam. Could you please clarify the rules? I want to be fully prepared. Thank you. Your guidance is very helpful. I appreciate your time. Please let me know as soon as possible.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, расскажите о том, как вы провели свой день рождения. Поблагодарите за её подарок.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, thank you for the lovely gift you sent for my birthday. I had a nice celebration with my friends. We had a cake and played games. I miss you. I wish you were here. I will visit you soon. Thank you for always remembering my special day.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, спросите, не хочет ли он присоединиться к вашей утренней пробежке. Скажите, что вы бегаете каждый день.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I go jogging every morning at 7 AM. Would you like to join me sometimes? It's a good way to start the day. Let me know if you are interested. I think it would be fun. We can motivate each other. I hope you can come.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, пожалуйтесь на неисправный кондиционер в номере. Попросите починить.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, the air conditioner in my room is not working properly. It is too warm. Could you please send someone to fix it? I would appreciate it. Thank you for your help. I hope it can be repaired soon. I look forward to your prompt action.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, предложите оптимизировать процесс закупок. Скажите, что это снизит расходы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I have an idea to optimize our procurement process. We could negotiate with suppliers for bulk discounts. This would reduce costs significantly. Can we discuss it? I think it could save us a lot of money. I am happy to provide more details.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, предложите бесплатную доставку при следующем заказе в качестве бонуса.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, as a thank you for your loyalty, we would like to offer you free delivery on your next order. Just use the code FREESHIP at checkout. We appreciate your business. We hope to see you again soon. Thank you for choosing us.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, согласуйте дату подписания нового контракта. Предложите провести подписание в вашем офисе.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, we are ready to sign the new contract. I propose we do it on July 25 at our office. Let me know if that suits you. I look forward to our partnership. Please confirm your availability. I am excited about our future cooperation.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своей новой квартире. Опишите её комнаты и расположение.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I moved to a new flat. It has two rooms and a big balcony. The kitchen is modern. It is near the metro. I'm very happy with it. You should visit sometime. I will give you a tour. I think you will like the place. Let me know when you are free.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, спросите, не хочет ли он поменяться сменами на следующей неделе. Объясните, что вам нужно уйти пораньше.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, could we swap shifts next Wednesday? I need to leave early for a doctor's appointment. I can take your shift on Friday instead. Let me know if it's possible. I would really appreciate it. Thank you for considering my request. I hope it works for you.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, спросите, будет ли контрольная работа на следующей неделе. Уточните тему.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, I would like to know if we have a test next week. What topics will it cover? I want to prepare well. Thank you for the information. Your help is much appreciated. I will start revising as soon as I know the details. Please let me know.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, расскажите о своём первом опыте вождения. Скажите, что вы уже сдали теорию.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, I passed my theory test! I am now learning to drive. It is a bit scary, but I am excited. I will tell you more when we meet. Wish me luck. I hope I can pass the practical test soon. I will keep you updated.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, спросите, не знает ли он хорошего сантехника. Объясните, что у вас протекает кран.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, do you know a good plumber? I have a leaky tap in the kitchen. It needs to be fixed soon. Any recommendation would be helpful. Thank you. I would be grateful for any contact. I need to get it repaired as soon as possible.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, попросите дополнительное полотенце и подушку в номер.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, could I please have an extra towel and an extra pillow in my room? The ones provided are not enough. Thank you for your help. I appreciate your assistance. Please send them as soon as possible. I hope it is not too much trouble.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, попросите перенести собрание на час позже. Объясните, что у вас важный звонок.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, could we postpone today's meeting by one hour? I have an urgent call at the original time. I apologize for the inconvenience. Thank you. I hope this is possible. I will join as soon as my call finishes. I appreciate your understanding.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, сообщите о поступлении нового товара. Предложите ознакомиться с каталогом.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are happy to inform you that new products have arrived. You can view them in our updated catalog. We look forward to your orders. Please contact us if you have any questions. We hope you find something you like. Thank you for your continued support.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, поблагодарите за участие в совместном мероприятии. Оцените его успех.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, thank you for participating in our joint event. It was a great success. We received positive feedback from all attendees. We hope to collaborate again soon. Your contribution was invaluable. I look forward to our next cooperation.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, расскажите о своём новом телефоне. Опишите его функции.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I bought a new smartphone. It has a great camera and a large screen. I can take amazing photos now. It's much faster than my old one. I love it. I will show you when we meet. I think you will like it too. It has many useful features.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, поздравьте с успешным завершением тренинга. Пожелайте применять знания.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, congratulations on completing the training! I hope you can apply the new knowledge in your work. I wish you continued success. You worked very hard. I am sure it will benefit you. Let me know if you need any help implementing what you learned.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, спросите, можно ли использовать компьютер для выполнения домашнего задания. Объясните, что у вас проблемы с почерком.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, could I type my homework on a computer? I have poor handwriting and it would be more readable. Thank you for understanding. I hope this is acceptable. I will still follow all the guidelines. Please let me know if there are any restrictions.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо бабушке, расскажите о своей новой работе. Спросите, как у неё здоровье.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Grandma, I started a new job as a teacher. I really enjoy it. How is your health? I hope you are feeling well. I will visit you soon. I miss you a lot. Please take care of yourself. I will call you this weekend to hear your voice.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, спросите, не пахнет ли у него газом. Предупредите, что вы чувствуете запах в подъезде.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I smell gas in the building. Do you notice it too? Please be careful and check your stove. I will call the gas company. Stay safe. It is better to be cautious. Let me know if you smell anything. I hope everything is fine.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, уточните, есть ли в номере фен. Спросите, можно ли попросить его на ресепшене.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, does my room have a hairdryer? If not, can I request one from the reception? I would appreciate it. Thank you. Please let me know if it is available. I will pick it up myself. I hope it is not a problem.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, предложите провести командообразующее мероприятие. Опишите, как это может помочь.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I suggest we organize a team-building event next month. It could help improve communication and morale. We could do a fun outdoor activity. Let me know your thoughts. I think it would be great for our team. I can help with the planning.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, попросите его подтвердить заказ по электронной почте. Объясните, что это необходимо для оформления.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, could you please confirm your order via email? We need your confirmation to proceed with the processing. Thank you for your cooperation. Please reply to this email. We will then finalize everything. We appreciate your help.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, поблагодарите за отличное сотрудничество за год. Отметьте достижения и планы на будущий год.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, thank you for a year of excellent cooperation. We achieved a lot together. We look forward to even greater successes next year. Happy holidays. I wish you and your team all the best. Let's continue our fruitful partnership. I am excited about the future.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своих планах на отпуск. Опишите, куда вы хотите поехать, что там делать и почему выбрали это место.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I'm so excited to tell you about my holiday plans. I've decided to go to the south of France for two weeks. I want to explore the beautiful coastline, visit some historical towns, and try the local cuisine. I chose this destination because I've heard the weather is perfect in July and the beaches are amazing. I'm also planning to take a boat trip to some nearby islands. I think it will be a fantastic adventure. Do you have any travel plans this summer? Let me know, maybe we can meet up somewhere.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором поблагодарите его за помощь в сложном проекте и предложите свою помощь в будущем. Опишите, что именно вам помогло.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for your invaluable help on the recent project. Your insights on the data analysis were extremely useful and saved us a lot of time. I particularly appreciated your willingness to stay late to finalize the report. I really couldn't have done it without you. I hope I can return the favour someday. If you ever need assistance with any of your tasks, please don't hesitate to ask. I would be more than happy to help you out. Thanks again for everything.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите разрешения на участие в профессиональном тренинге, который состоится в следующем месяце. Объясните, как это поможет вашей работе.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to request your permission to attend a professional training course on project management, which will take place next month. This course covers advanced techniques that I believe would significantly improve my efficiency in handling our current projects. I have researched the programme and it seems very practical and relevant to our work. The training lasts only two days, so it will not disrupt my schedule too much. I am confident that the skills I gain will benefit our team in the long run. I would be grateful if you could approve my participation. Thank you for your consideration.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором извинитесь за задержку поставки и объясните причину. Предложите компенсацию за неудобства.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are writing to sincerely apologize for the delay in delivering your order. Unfortunately, we encountered an unexpected issue with our shipping partner, which has caused a backlog. We understand that this is very inconvenient for you, and we deeply regret the situation. Your order is now scheduled to arrive by the end of this week. As a gesture of goodwill, we would like to offer you a 15% discount on your next purchase. We hope this compensation in some way makes up for the inconvenience. Please let us know if you have any further questions.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру по бизнесу, предложите провести совместную маркетинговую акцию для привлечения новых клиентов. Опишите свои идеи.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to propose a joint marketing campaign to attract new clients to both our businesses. I was thinking of offering a combined package where customers get a discount on our services when they purchase from you, and vice versa. We could promote this through social media and email newsletters. I believe this would be beneficial for both of us as it would expand our customer base without huge costs. Let me know if you are interested and we can discuss the details further. I look forward to your positive response.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о неудачном опыте в ресторане. Опишите, что пошло не так, и скажите, что вы чувствовали.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I had a really disappointing experience at the new Italian restaurant last night. The service was extremely slow, and the waiter got our order wrong. When the food finally arrived, it was cold and tasted bland. I was looking forward to trying their pasta, but it was undercooked. To make matters worse, they charged us for items we didn't order. I felt quite frustrated and let down. I don't think I'll be going back there anytime soon. Have you had any similar experiences? I would love to hear your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором попросите изменить дату вашего заезда на день раньше. Объясните причину и извинитесь за неудобства.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I am writing to request a change to my booking. I currently have a reservation for July 10, but I would like to check in one day earlier, on July 9. Unfortunately, my travel plans have changed unexpectedly. I understand that this may cause some inconvenience, and I apologize for that. I would be very grateful if you could accommodate this request. Please let me know if there is any additional charge. I have already sent you my booking reference number. Thank you for your understanding and assistance.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, в котором поблагодарите его за то, что он присматривал за вашей квартирой во время вашего отсутствия. Спросите, всё ли было в порядке.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I just wanted to thank you very much for keeping an eye on my apartment while I was away on holiday. I really appreciate your kindness and reliability. I hope nothing unusual happened during my absence. Did you notice any problems with the mail or anything else? Everything seems fine now that I am back, but I wanted to check with you just in case. If you ever need a favour in return, please do not hesitate to ask me. Thanks again for your help. It gave me peace of mind knowing that you were looking after things.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите внедрить систему регулярных коротких собраний для улучшения коммуникации в команде. Объясните, почему это важно.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to suggest that we introduce short daily meetings to improve communication within our team. I believe that a 15-minute stand-up each morning would help everyone stay aligned on priorities and address any issues early on. This practice could prevent misunderstandings and increase our overall efficiency. Many companies have found such meetings very beneficial. I am confident that even a brief daily check-in would make a noticeable difference. I would be happy to help organize this. Please let me know what you think. I look forward to your feedback.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о книге, которая вас вдохновила. Опишите, о чём она и почему она вам понравилась.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I recently read a book that really inspired me. It's called 'The Alchemist' by Paulo Coelho. The story is about a young shepherd who goes on a journey to find his personal legend. It's a simple but profound tale about following your dreams and listening to your heart. I found it very motivating because it reminded me that the journey itself is just as important as the destination. I think you would enjoy it too. I would be happy to lend it to you if you are interested. Let me know what you think.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором сообщите, что его заказ готов к отправке, и уточните детали доставки. Предложите выбрать удобное время.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are pleased to inform you that your order is now ready for shipment. The items have been packed and are in perfect condition. We would like to arrange delivery at a time that suits you best. Could you please let us know your preferred delivery date and time slot? We can offer morning or afternoon deliveries. Please also confirm the delivery address to ensure accuracy. We aim to make this process as smooth as possible for you. We look forward to your response and thank you for choosing us.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите итоги совместного проекта и предложите новые направления для сотрудничества. Оцените успехи.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to take this opportunity to review the results of our recent joint project. I am very pleased with the outcome – we managed to exceed our targets and received excellent feedback from clients. This success clearly shows that our collaboration is strong and effective. I believe we should explore new areas where we can work together. Perhaps we could consider expanding into new markets or developing a new product line. I am open to any suggestions you might have. Let's schedule a meeting to discuss our future plans. I look forward to continuing our partnership.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо учителю, в котором попросите дополнительное задание для улучшения своих навыков. Объясните, что вы хотите больше практиковаться.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear teacher, I hope you are doing well. I am writing to ask if you could provide me with some extra assignments or exercises to help me improve my English skills. I feel that I need more practice, especially in writing and grammar. I am willing to put in extra effort outside class. If you could recommend any materials or give me some additional tasks, I would be very grateful. I want to make the most of this course and achieve better results. Thank you for your understanding and support. I appreciate your help.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором предложите вместе посетить профессиональную конференцию. Объясните, почему это может быть полезно для вас обоих.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I was wondering if you would be interested in attending the upcoming industry conference with me. It will take place next month and covers many topics relevant to our field. I think it would be a great opportunity for us to learn about the latest trends, network with other professionals, and gain new insights that we could apply to our work. Plus, it could be a good chance for us to discuss our projects outside the office. Let me know if you are interested. I can look up the registration details and we can plan our attendance together.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите пересмотреть вашу рабочую нагрузку, так как вы чувствуете переутомление. Предложите конкретные решения.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to discuss my current workload, which has become quite overwhelming lately. I have been working long hours and I am starting to feel exhausted, which is affecting my productivity and well-being. I would like to request a review of my tasks to see if some can be redistributed or postponed. For example, I could delegate some routine tasks to junior team members or postpone non-urgent projects. I am committed to delivering quality work, but I need a more sustainable pace. I hope we can find a solution together. Thank you for your understanding.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своей поездке в горы. Опишите природу, погоду и то, что вы там делали.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I've just come back from a wonderful trip to the mountains. The weather was perfect – sunny but not too hot. I went hiking every day and the scenery was breathtaking. The trails were surrounded by pine forests and there were beautiful lakes at every turn. I also enjoyed the fresh air and the peace and quiet away from the city. In the evenings, we sat around a campfire and watched the stars. It was exactly what I needed to recharge. I wish you could have been there. Let's plan a trip together sometime!

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором пожалуйтесь на плохое качество уборки в номере. Попросите улучшить ситуацию.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the cleanliness of my room. When I arrived, I noticed that the bathroom was not properly cleaned, and there was dust on some surfaces. I have already reported this to the reception, but I wanted to bring it to your attention as well. I believe that a hotel of your standard should maintain higher levels of cleanliness. I would appreciate it if you could ensure that my room is thoroughly cleaned today. I hope this issue will be resolved promptly. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором предложите провести вебинар для ваших общих клиентов. Опишите тему и возможные выгоды.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to propose that we jointly organize a webinar for our shared clients. The topic could be 'Navigating the Post-Pandemic Business Landscape'. I believe this would be very valuable for our clients and would also enhance our reputation as thought leaders. We could split the presentation and include a Q&A session. This would also be a great opportunity to showcase our expertise and strengthen our relationship with clients. Let me know if you are interested. I can start working on the content and we can decide on a date that suits both of us.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором поздравьте его с успешным завершением важного этапа работы. Выразите свою признательность за командную работу.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I wanted to congratulate you on successfully completing the crucial phase of our project. Your dedication and hard work were instrumental in reaching this milestone. I really appreciated how you coordinated the team and kept everyone motivated. It was a pleasure working alongside you. I believe this achievement will have a positive impact on our future tasks. Thank you for your contribution and for being such a reliable partner. I look forward to collaborating with you on the next stages. Well done!

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите улучшить условия работы в офисе (например, добавить растения или улучшить освещение). Аргументируйте пользу.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to suggest some improvements to our office environment to enhance employee well-being and productivity. I have noticed that the lighting in our area could be brighter, and adding some plants might improve air quality and create a more pleasant atmosphere. Studies have shown that such changes can boost mood and reduce stress. I think even small adjustments would make a difference. I would be happy to help select suitable plants or lighting options. I hope you will consider these suggestions. Thank you for taking the time to read my proposal.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором поделитесь своими мыслями о прочитанной статье или новости. Объясните, почему это вас заинтересовало.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I just read an interesting article about the impact of artificial intelligence on the job market. It made me think about how quickly things are changing and how we might need to adapt. The article suggested that many routine jobs could be automated in the next decade, but new roles will also emerge. I found it both worrying and exciting. I think it's important to stay informed and keep learning new skills. What do you think about this topic? Do you have any concerns or hopes about AI? I'd love to hear your perspective.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором подтвердите получение его запроса и сообщите, что вы работаете над ним. Обещайте ответить в ближайшее время.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are writing to confirm that we have received your request and it is now being processed by our team. We understand that this matter is important to you, and we are giving it our full attention. We will get back to you with a detailed response within two business days. If you need any further information in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us. We appreciate your patience and trust in our services. We are committed to providing you with a satisfactory solution. Thank you for choosing us.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, в котором предложите вместе организовать уборку подъезда. Обсудите возможные даты и распределение задач.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I have noticed that our entrance could use a good cleaning. I thought it might be a good idea to organize a joint effort to tidy up the common areas. We could do it next Saturday morning. I can take care of mopping the floors, and perhaps you could clean the windows or the stairs. If you have any other suggestions, I am open to them. Let me know if that date works for you and if you have any preferences for tasks. I think it will be more fun if we do it together and it will make our building more pleasant for everyone.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите разрешения на использование гибкого графика работы (например, начало позже) по личным причинам. Объясните, как это не повлияет на работу.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to request a flexible work schedule for personal reasons. I would like to start my workday one hour later and finish one hour later on certain days, if possible. I believe this arrangement would help me manage some family commitments more effectively. I assure you that my productivity will not be affected, as I will still complete all my tasks on time. I am also willing to be available online during the core hours as needed. I hope you will consider this request favourably. Thank you for your understanding.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите возможность обмена опытом между вашими командами для улучшения навыков. Предложите конкретные шаги.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to propose an initiative to exchange knowledge and experience between our teams. I believe this could be very beneficial for both sides, as we could learn new approaches and improve our skills. For example, we could organize joint workshops where each team shares their best practices. We could also arrange job shadowing for a few days. I suggest we start with a pilot programme and then evaluate the results. Please let me know your thoughts. I am confident that this collaboration would strengthen our partnership and enhance our capabilities.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своём новом увлечении (например, рисование или кулинария). Объясните, почему вам это нравится, и предложите попробовать вместе.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I've recently taken up watercolour painting and I absolutely love it. It's so relaxing to mix colours and create something beautiful. I find it a great way to unwind after a stressful day. I think you would enjoy it too – it's not as difficult as it looks! Would you like to try it with me sometime? We could have a painting session together and I can teach you the basics. It would be fun to share this hobby with you. Let me know if you are interested. I hope you will join me!

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором примите во внимание его пожелания по поводу продукта и сообщите, что вы внесли изменения. Объясните, что было изменено.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we would like to thank you for your valuable feedback on our product. We have carefully reviewed your suggestions and implemented several changes based on your recommendations. Specifically, we have improved the user interface and added a new feature that you requested. We believe these updates will significantly enhance your experience. We are always striving to meet our clients' needs, and your input is crucial to that process. We hope you will be satisfied with the new version. Please do not hesitate to share any further comments.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором предложите вместе подготовиться к презентации. Предложите разделить работу и обсудить структуру.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I think we should start preparing for the upcoming presentation to the board. I propose we work on it together so we can combine our ideas and create a strong, coherent presentation. We could divide the work – you could handle the financial part, and I could focus on the market analysis. Let's also agree on a structure and a timeline. Maybe we can meet tomorrow to outline the main points. I believe that with our combined efforts, we will deliver a compelling presentation. Let me know what you think. I am looking forward to working with you on this.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите внедрить новую систему обратной связи с сотрудниками для повышения вовлечённости. Опишите, как это может работать.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to propose implementing a regular feedback system to increase employee engagement. I suggest we conduct quarterly anonymous surveys to gather opinions and suggestions from all team members. The results could then be discussed in team meetings, and we could take action on the most common concerns. This would help employees feel heard and valued, and it might also improve retention. I have seen positive results with this approach in other companies. I would be happy to assist with designing the survey and analyzing the responses. Please let me know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о фильме, который вас разочаровал. Опишите, что вам не понравилось, и сравните с ожиданиями.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I finally watched that movie everyone was talking about, and I have to say I was quite disappointed. The trailer made it look very exciting, but the actual film was slow and predictable. The acting was average, and the plot had too many holes. I expected a thrilling story, but it turned out to be quite boring. Maybe my expectations were too high because of all the hype. I think I would have enjoyed it more if I hadn't heard so many good reviews beforehand. Have you seen it? I would be curious to know your opinion. Maybe I just missed something.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором попросите организовать экскурсию по городу. Уточните, какие достопримечательности вы хотели бы посетить.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would like to inquire about arranging a guided tour of the city during my stay. I am particularly interested in visiting the historical landmarks, such as the cathedral and the old town square. I would also like to see the local museum. Could you please recommend a tour company and let me know about the availability and prices? I would prefer a small group tour if possible. I would be grateful for your assistance in organizing this. Please let me know the details. Thank you for your help.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите увеличить бюджет на маркетинговые мероприятия. Аргументируйте, почему это необходимо для роста.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to request an increase in our marketing budget for the next quarter. We have identified several new channels that could significantly boost our reach and attract more customers. With additional funding, we could run more effective campaigns and test new strategies. I believe this investment would lead to a substantial increase in sales and brand awareness. I have prepared a detailed plan and estimated costs. I am confident that the return on investment would be positive. I hope you will consider my proposal favourably. Thank you for your time.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите возможные изменения в совместном проекте из-за новых рыночных условий. Предложите адаптировать стратегию.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I believe we need to review our joint project in light of recent market developments. Some of our initial assumptions may no longer hold true, and we might need to adapt our approach to remain competitive. I suggest we re-evaluate the target audience and consider adjusting the product features accordingly. We could also explore new distribution channels. I would like to schedule a meeting to discuss these adjustments and agree on a revised plan. Let me know your availability. I think it's important to act quickly to seize the opportunities that have emerged.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором поблагодарите его за своевременную помощь и пообещайте ответную услугу. Опишите, в чём именно заключалась помощь.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I am writing to thank you for your prompt assistance with the client report yesterday. Your quick response and input saved me a lot of time and stress. I really appreciated your willingness to drop everything and help me out. I hope I can return the favour someday. Please let me know if there is anything I can help you with in the future. It's great to have such a supportive colleague. Thanks again for your kindness and professionalism. I value our collaboration.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором предложите бесплатную пробную версию вашего нового продукта. Объясните, как это может помочь ему.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are excited to offer you a free trial of our new software product. We believe it can greatly improve your workflow and help you manage your tasks more efficiently. The trial period lasts for 30 days and includes full access to all features. We would love to hear your feedback during this time. If you find it useful, you can easily upgrade to a paid plan. I think this would be a great opportunity for you to experience the benefits without any commitment. Let me know if you are interested.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, в котором извинитесь за шум от вечеринки, которая была на прошлых выходных. Объясните, что это был особый случай.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I want to sincerely apologize for the noise from my party last Saturday. It was a special occasion – my birthday – and I invited a few more people than I had planned. I understand that it was quite loud and may have disturbed you. I am truly sorry for that. I will try to ensure that any future gatherings are quieter. Please let me know if there is anything I can do to make up for it. I value having a good relationship with my neighbors. Thank you for your understanding.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите провести регулярные обзоры проектов для выявления проблем на ранних стадиях. Опишите предполагаемую пользу.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to suggest conducting regular project reviews at key milestones to identify potential issues before they escalate. These reviews would involve the whole team and could help us stay on track and avoid delays. I believe this would improve our efficiency and the quality of our deliverables. We could set aside 30 minutes every two weeks to assess progress and address any challenges. I think this proactive approach would be very beneficial. I am willing to help organize these meetings. Let me know what you think.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своём опыте участия в благотворительном мероприятии. Опишите, что вы делали и какие впечатления получили.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I recently took part in a charity run to raise funds for a local children's hospital. It was such a rewarding experience. I ran 5 kilometers along with hundreds of other participants. The atmosphere was incredibly positive and everyone was so supportive. Seeing the children and their families cheering us on was very moving. I felt that I was really making a difference, even if in a small way. I would definitely participate in similar events in the future. It made me realize how good it feels to contribute to a good cause.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором попросите рекомендовать хороший ресторан недалеко от отеля. Опишите свои предпочтения в кухне.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would appreciate it if you could recommend a good restaurant near the hotel. I am in the mood for Italian or seafood cuisine, but I am open to other suggestions as well. I would prefer a place with a pleasant atmosphere and reasonable prices. It would also be great if it is within walking distance. I have heard good things about some local eateries, but I trust your advice. Thank you for your help. I look forward to trying some delicious food during my stay.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором предложите совместно разработать новый продукт. Опишите концепцию и потенциальный рынок.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I have a concept for a new product that I believe could be very successful, and I would like to propose we develop it together. The idea is a smart home device that helps users save energy. I have done some preliminary research and found that there is a growing demand for such products. I have also identified potential target markets and distribution channels. I would love to share more details with you and discuss how we could collaborate on this venture. Please let me know if you are interested. I look forward to exploring this opportunity with you.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором попросите его проверить вашу презентацию перед важной встречей. Укажите, что вам нужен свежий взгляд.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I have a presentation for a key client tomorrow, and I would be very grateful if you could take a quick look at it. I need a fresh perspective to ensure that the content is clear and the design is professional. I've already prepared the slides, but I would appreciate your feedback on the flow and the key messages. Could you please have a look and let me know your thoughts? Your input would be very valuable. I know you are busy, but even a short review would help. Thank you in advance for your support.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите разрешения на дополнительный выходной для участия в семейном мероприятии. Объясните важность этого события.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to request an additional day off on Friday, July 15, to attend a family wedding. This is a very important event for me, as it is my sister's wedding, and I have been looking forward to it for a long time. I will ensure that all my tasks are completed before that date, and I will be available by phone if anything urgent comes up. I hope you can grant me this time off. I understand that it is short notice, but I would be very grateful for your understanding. Thank you for considering my request.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором сообщите, что вы обновили продукт на основе его отзывов. Опишите улучшения и попросите повторного отзыва.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are pleased to inform you that we have updated our product based on your valuable feedback. We have enhanced the user interface and added new features that you suggested, such as advanced search filters and a more intuitive dashboard. We believe these changes will significantly improve your experience. We would be very grateful if you could try the new version and share your thoughts with us. Your opinion is extremely important to us and helps us continue to improve. Thank you for your continued support and trust in our company.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором поделитесь новостью о том, что вы начали учить иностранный язык. Расскажите, почему вы выбрали этот язык и как продвигается обучение.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I have some exciting news – I've started learning Spanish! I've always wanted to learn it because I love the culture and I plan to travel to Spain next year. The learning process is challenging but really enjoyable. I'm using an app for daily practice and I've also found a language partner online. I can already say some basic phrases and understand a bit of conversation. I'm really motivated and I hope to become fluent eventually. Have you ever learned a language? I would love to hear your tips and experiences.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором сообщите, что вы потеряли ключ от номера, и попросите сделать дубликат. Извинитесь за неудобство.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I am afraid I have lost the key to my room. I am very sorry for the inconvenience this may cause. I have already checked my bag and pockets, but I cannot find it anywhere. Could you please make a duplicate key for me? I will be more careful in the future. I understand that this might be a hassle, and I apologize once again. Please let me know if there is any procedure I need to follow. I would appreciate your help. Thank you for your assistance.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите провести обучение для сотрудников по новому программному обеспечению. Объясните, как это повысит эффективность.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I propose that we organize a training session for our team on the new software that we will be using starting next month. Many employees are not familiar with it, and I believe a structured training would help them adapt faster and use it more effectively. This would reduce errors and save time in the long run. I can arrange for an external trainer or we could have internal sessions led by experienced users. I would like to discuss this with you and get your approval. Please let me know your thoughts. I am confident this investment will pay off.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите результаты вашей совместной рекламной кампании. Оцените её эффективность и предложите продолжать сотрудничество.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I wanted to share the results of our recent joint advertising campaign. I am pleased to say that it was very successful – we saw a 20% increase in website traffic and a noticeable rise in enquiries. I think this clearly shows the effectiveness of our collaboration. I would like to propose that we continue this partnership and possibly expand it to other channels. I believe we can achieve even better results with more targeted content. Let me know your thoughts. I look forward to our continued cooperation.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором предложите вместе посетить выставку, связанную с вашей отраслью. Объясните, почему это может быть полезно.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! There is a big industry exhibition coming up next month, and I thought it would be a great opportunity for us to attend together. It features many companies showcasing new technologies and services. I believe we can gain valuable insights into market trends and network with other professionals. It could also give us ideas for improving our own projects. Let me know if you are interested. I can check the dates and we can plan our visit. I think it will be both educational and inspiring. I hope you can come.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором поблагодарите за долгосрочное сотрудничество и предложите специальное условие для продолжения работы. Опишите это условие.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we would like to express our sincere gratitude for your long-term partnership with us. We truly appreciate your trust and loyalty over the years. As a token of our appreciation, we would like to offer you a 10% discount on all future orders for the next six months. We hope this will encourage you to continue working with us and that you will find it beneficial. We are committed to providing you with the highest quality service. Thank you for choosing us as your partner.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о планах на выходные и спросите о его планах. Предложите провести время вместе.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I'm trying to plan my weekend and I was wondering if you have any plans. I was thinking we could go to the cinema on Saturday evening – there's a new comedy that looks really funny. Or if you prefer, we could just grab a coffee and walk in the park. It would be great to catch up and relax after a long week. Let me know what you think. If you have any other suggestions, I'm open to them. I hope we can spend some time together. Looking forward to hearing from you!

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите организовать небольшой корпоратив в честь успешного завершения проекта. Опишите свои идеи и возможную пользу для команды.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to suggest organizing a small team party to celebrate the successful completion of our project. I believe this would be a great way to acknowledge everyone's hard work and boost team morale. We could order some food and drinks, or even have a short outdoor activity if the weather is nice. It doesn't have to be expensive or time-consuming, but I think it would help strengthen our team spirit. I am happy to help with the planning. Please let me know your thoughts. I hope we can make it happen.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором попросите его совета по выбору нового программного обеспечения для ваших задач. Опишите свои требования и спросите его мнение.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I am currently looking for new project management software to help us track tasks more efficiently. I need something that is easy to use, supports team collaboration, and has good reporting features. I know you have experience with several tools, so I would really appreciate your advice. What would you recommend for our type of work? I have tried a couple of options, but I am not completely satisfied. I would value your opinion before I make a final decision. Let me know when you have a moment. Thanks in advance for your help.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своём недавнем опыте посещения концерта. Опишите атмосферу, музыку и свои впечатления.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I went to an amazing concert last night. The band played my favourite songs and the energy in the crowd was incredible. Everyone was singing along and dancing. The lights and sound effects made the whole experience unforgettable. I felt so happy and alive. I haven't had such a good time in a long while. I wish you had been there with me – I think you would have loved it too. We should definitely go to a concert together sometime. Let me know if you have any upcoming gigs planned.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором попросите организовать поздний выезд в день отъезда, так как ваш рейс вечером. Уточните, готовы ли вы доплатить.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I am writing to request a late check-out on the day of my departure, as my flight is not until the evening. I would like to keep the room until 5 PM if possible. I understand that this may incur an extra charge, and I am willing to pay for it. It would be much more convenient for me to rest and freshen up before heading to the airport. Please let me know if this is possible and what the additional cost would be. Thank you for your understanding and assistance. I appreciate your help.
