beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите внедрить систему поощрений для сотрудников, которые достигают целей. Опишите, как это может повысить мотивацию.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to suggest introducing a reward system for employees who consistently achieve their targets. This could include bonuses, extra days off, or public recognition. I believe such a system would significantly boost motivation and encourage everyone to perform better. It would also show that we value hard work and dedication. I have seen similar practices in other companies, and they often lead to higher productivity and job satisfaction. I would be happy to help design a fair and transparent reward structure. Please let me know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите возможность совместного участия в благотворительном мероприятии. Предложите несколько идей и спросите его мнение.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I was thinking that we could join forces for a charity event to give back to our community. I have a few ideas: we could organize a food drive, sponsor a local sports team, or even participate in a charity run. I believe this would not only help those in need but also improve our brand image and strengthen our partnership. It would be a great way to show our shared values. What do you think? Do you have any preferences or other suggestions? Let me know your thoughts. I am open to any ideas you might have.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором поблагодарите его за поддержку в сложный период и поделитесь своими планами на будущее. Выразите надежду на дальнейшее сотрудничество.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I wanted to thank you for your unwavering support during the recent challenging period. Your encouragement and practical help made a huge difference. I am feeling much more positive now and have started making plans for the coming months. I hope we can continue working closely together and achieve even more. Your professionalism and kindness are greatly appreciated. I look forward to our future projects. Please let me know if there is anything I can do to support you in return.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором предложите обновлённый сервисный пакет с улучшенными условиями. Опишите, что нового и почему это может быть выгодно.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are excited to announce an updated service package with improved conditions. The new package includes faster response times, dedicated account management, and access to premium features at no extra cost. We believe these enhancements will add significant value to your experience with us. This upgrade is designed to meet your evolving needs and ensure you get the most out of our services. I would be happy to provide more details and discuss how this could benefit your business. Please let us know if you are interested.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своих достижениях в фитнесе за последний месяц. Опишите, как вы тренировались и какие результаты получили.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I've been working out regularly for the past month and I'm really proud of my progress. I started running three times a week and also do strength training twice a week. I can already feel that I have more energy and my stamina has improved a lot. I've even lost a few kilos and my clothes fit better now. It's been a great motivation to keep going. I'm also sleeping better and feeling less stressed. If you ever want to join me for a run, just let me know. It's always more fun with a friend.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите разрешения на проведение эксперимента с новым подходом к работе. Объясните, почему вы считаете это перспективным.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to request permission to run a small experiment with a new approach to task management. I believe that implementing a more flexible methodology could improve our team's efficiency and creativity. I plan to test this on a pilot project over the next four weeks. If successful, we could then consider rolling it out more broadly. I have prepared a detailed plan and evaluation criteria. I am confident that this experiment will provide valuable insights. Please let me know if you approve. I am happy to discuss it further.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором поблагодарите за отличный отдых и поделитесь положительным отзывом. Скажите, что обязательно вернётесь.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I wanted to thank you for a wonderful stay at your hotel. Everything was perfect – the room was spotless, the staff were friendly and helpful, and the food was delicious. I especially enjoyed the pool and the beautiful view. I will definitely be coming back next year and will recommend your hotel to all my friends. It's rare to find such high-quality service. Thank you for making my holiday so memorable. I look forward to my next visit.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором предложите совместный анализ эффективности ваших текущих рекламных каналов. Объясните, как это может помочь оптимизировать бюджет.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I suggest we collaborate on analysing the effectiveness of our current advertising channels. By combining our data, we can identify which channels generate the best return on investment and where we might be wasting money. This would allow us to reallocate our budget more efficiently and improve our overall campaign performance. I have already compiled some initial statistics and would be happy to share them with you. Please let me know if you are interested. I think this collaboration would be mutually beneficial.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором попросите его заменить вас на встрече с заказчиком, так как у вас возникли непредвиденные обстоятельства. Предложите всю необходимую информацию.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I have an unexpected emergency and cannot attend the meeting with the client tomorrow. I was wondering if you could possibly replace me. I will send you all the relevant documents and a brief summary of the key points we need to discuss. The client is expecting a presentation on our latest proposal. I am confident you can handle it. I really appreciate your help. Please let me know if you need any additional information. Thank you so much for stepping in.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своей поездке в новое место, которое вас впечатлило. Опишите природу, людей и то, что вы там делали.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I just returned from a trip to a small village in the countryside, and I was truly amazed by its beauty. The landscape was stunning – rolling hills, green meadows, and a peaceful river. The locals were incredibly friendly and welcoming. I spent my days hiking, exploring the forests, and trying local dishes. It was so refreshing to escape the city noise and breathe fresh air. I took so many photos that I will show you when we meet. I would love to go back there someday.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите создать внутренний блог для обмена знаниями между сотрудниками. Опишите, как это может способствовать обучению.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to propose the creation of an internal blog where employees can share their expertise and insights. This would be a great platform for learning from each other and staying updated on best practices. Employees could post articles, tips, or even short tutorials on topics relevant to their work. I believe this would foster a culture of continuous learning and collaboration. I would be happy to help set it up and moderate the content. I think it could become a valuable resource for our team. Please let me know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором извинитесь за ошибку в выставленном счёте и сообщите, что вы её исправили. Уточните правильную сумму.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we apologize for the error in the invoice we sent you last week. We have identified a mistake in the calculation, and we have now corrected it. The correct amount is $1,200, not $1,350. We are very sorry for any confusion this may have caused. We have already sent you a revised invoice with the correct amount. Please disregard the previous one. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us. We appreciate your understanding and thank you for your patience.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите возможность расширения ассортимента продукции на основе отзывов клиентов. Предложите несколько новых идей.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I believe we should consider expanding our product range based on the positive feedback we have received from our clients. Many customers have expressed interest in eco-friendly and sustainable options. I suggest we explore adding a new line of organic or recycled materials. We could also introduce a subscription model for repeat customers. I have some initial concepts and would like to discuss them with you. Please let me know when you are available for a call. I think this could open up new opportunities.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором поблагодарите его за проведённый тренинг для новых сотрудников. Оцените его вклад и скажите, как это помогло команде.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I wanted to thank you for the excellent training session you delivered to our new hires last week. Your explanations were clear and engaging, and the new employees have already started applying what they learned. I have received very positive feedback from them. Your contribution has made their onboarding much smoother and has saved us a lot of time. I really appreciate the effort you put into preparing the materials. Thank you again for your dedication. I look forward to working with you on future training initiatives.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите пересмотреть возможности для профессионального роста в компании. Выразите своё желание развиваться и взять на себя больше ответственности.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to express my interest in taking on additional responsibilities and growing professionally within the company. I feel that I have gained valuable experience in my current role and I am ready for new challenges. I would like to discuss possible opportunities for advancement or involvement in more complex projects. I am very committed to contributing to our team's success and I believe I can add more value. I would be grateful if we could schedule a meeting to explore this further. Thank you for your support.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своём опыте работы волонтёром. Опишите, что вы делали и какие эмоции это вызвало.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I recently started volunteering at a local animal shelter and it has been a truly rewarding experience. I help walk the dogs, clean their kennels, and feed them. It's so heart-warming to see how happy they get when they are taken care of. I also get to spend time with the animals and give them the attention they need. I feel that I am making a small difference, and it gives me a great sense of purpose. I would highly recommend volunteering to anyone. It really changes your perspective on life.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором спросите, есть ли в отеле прачечная и сколько стоит услуга. Уточните время выполнения заказов.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would like to inquire about the laundry service available at your hotel. Could you please tell me if you offer this service and what the costs are? I would also like to know how long it usually takes to get clothes back. I have some items that need washing and I would like to plan accordingly. If possible, please also let me know if you offer same-day service. Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your reply.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите провести опрос среди сотрудников для выявления их потребностей и улучшения условий труда. Аргументируйте важность обратной связи.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I suggest we conduct a survey among employees to better understand their needs and concerns regarding working conditions. This would give us valuable feedback on areas that could be improved, such as workload, equipment, or office environment. By listening to our team, we can create a more comfortable and productive workplace. I believe this would also increase employee satisfaction and retention. I can help design and distribute the survey. I hope you will consider this suggestion. It would be a relatively simple step that could have a big impact.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором предложите бесплатную консультацию по использованию вашего продукта для повышения его эффективности. Опишите, как это может помочь.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we would like to offer you a free consultation session on how to maximize the benefits of our product. Our experts will guide you through advanced features and show you tips to improve your workflow. We believe that this will help you get even more value from your investment. The session can be scheduled at your convenience and lasts about 45 minutes. We have received positive feedback from other clients who have taken advantage of this service. Please let us know if you are interested. We are here to support you.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите планы по выходу на новый рынок. Оцените риски и возможные стратегии адаптации.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to discuss our plans to enter a new market in the upcoming quarter. I have conducted a preliminary analysis and identified some potential risks, such as regulatory hurdles and cultural differences. I believe that a careful adaptation strategy is essential. We could consider partnering with a local firm to ease the transition. I would also suggest starting with a pilot launch in a smaller region to test the waters. I would appreciate your input on these ideas. Let's schedule a meeting to go over the details.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором попросите его помочь с подготовкой важного отчёта. Опишите, в чём именно нужна помощь, и укажите сроки.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I am working on an important report that needs to be submitted by Friday. I could really use your help with the data analysis section, as you have more experience with those tools. I have already prepared the raw data and a draft structure. I would need your input on the interpretation and presentation of the results. Could we work on this together tomorrow afternoon? Your expertise would be invaluable. Please let me know if you are available. I would be very grateful for your assistance.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором поделитесь новостью о том, что вы купили новый дом или квартиру. Опишите, какая она, и пригласите друга в гости.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I have some exciting news to share – I just bought a new apartment! It's in a quiet neighborhood, has two bedrooms, and a lovely balcony with a view of the park. I'm still in the process of decorating, but I can't wait to show it to you. I would love to invite you over for a housewarming party once everything is ready. It would be great to celebrate this new chapter with you. Let me know when you are free. I hope you like it as much as I do.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите проводить регулярные короткие встречи для обмена новостями и планами. Опишите, как это улучшит координацию.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to propose holding brief weekly meetings to share updates and plans. These meetings would help us stay aligned on our goals and avoid any misunderstandings. Each person could give a quick summary of their progress and any blockers they are facing. I think this would greatly improve our coordination and efficiency. It would also be a good opportunity to celebrate small wins. I suggest we keep them to 15 minutes. I am happy to take the lead on organising them. Please let me know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором сообщите, что его предложение принято, и обсудите следующие шаги. Выразите энтузиазм по поводу сотрудничества.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are delighted to inform you that your proposal has been accepted! We are very excited about the opportunity to work with you on this project. The next steps will be to finalize the contract and set up an initial planning meeting. I will send you the draft agreement later this week. We believe that this partnership will be very successful and look forward to contributing to your goals. Please let us know if you have any questions in the meantime. We are fully committed to making this project a great success.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо соседу, в котором предложите вместе посадить деревья или цветы во дворе. Объясните, как это улучшит внешний вид и атмосферу.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear neighbor, I was thinking that it would be nice to add some greenery to our courtyard. Perhaps we could plant some flowers or small trees together. I believe this would greatly improve the appearance of our building and make it more pleasant for everyone. I have already checked with the building manager and they are supportive. I could bring the plants and tools if you are willing to help with the planting. Let me know if you are interested and what time would suit you. I think it would be a fun and rewarding project.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором предложите провести совместную акцию для привлечения новых клиентов. Опишите формат и потенциальные выгоды.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to propose a joint promotion to attract new clients. We could offer a special discount for customers who purchase services from both of us within a limited period. This would create a win-win situation: they get a better deal, and we both gain new business. I suggest we promote this through our social media channels and email newsletters. I believe this initiative could significantly boost our client base. I would be happy to discuss the details and plan the campaign together. Let me know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором поблагодарите его за отличную совместную работу над проектом. Выразите надежду на дальнейшее сотрудничество.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for your excellent work on our recent project. Your dedication, creativity, and professionalism made a huge contribution to its success. It was a pleasure to collaborate with you. I truly appreciate the effort you put in. I hope we can work together on many more projects in the future. I think we make a great team. Thank you again for everything. I look forward to our next opportunity to collaborate.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите улучшить систему обучения для новых сотрудников. Опишите, что можно добавить или изменить.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to suggest some improvements to our onboarding process for new employees. I think we could add more hands-on training sessions and provide a clear guide for the first few weeks. I also suggest assigning a mentor to each new hire to help them settle in faster. This would reduce the learning curve and make them feel more supported. I have seen this approach work well in other companies. I would be happy to help develop the materials and structure. Please let me know what you think.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своих планах на отпуск и спросите, не хочет ли он присоединиться. Опишите, что вы будете делать.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I'm planning a holiday to the coast next month and I was wondering if you would like to join me. I'm thinking of staying for a week, swimming, sunbathing, and exploring the local towns. I've found a nice cottage near the beach that can accommodate two people. It would be great to have some company and share the experience. Let me know if you are interested. I can send you the details and we can plan together. I really hope you can make it!

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором попросите информацию о доступных спа-услугах и их ценах. Уточните, нужно ли бронировать заранее.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would like to inquire about the spa services offered at your hotel. Could you please provide me with a list of available treatments and their prices? I am particularly interested in massage and facial treatments. I would also like to know if I need to book in advance and whether there are any special packages. I am planning to enjoy some relaxation during my stay. Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your reply.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите провести внешний аудит для оценки эффективности работы отдела. Объясните, какие выгоды это принесёт.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I propose that we commission an external audit of our department's performance to identify areas for improvement. An independent review could highlight inefficiencies and suggest best practices that we might have overlooked. This would help us enhance our productivity and better align with company goals. I understand that this would require some investment, but I believe it would pay off in the long run. I have already contacted a few reputable firms for initial consultations. Please let me know your thoughts. I am happy to provide more details.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором предложите вместе посетить мастер-класс по развитию навыков. Опишите, чему можно научиться и почему это полезно.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I came across a workshop on effective communication that I think could be really useful for us. It covers active listening, giving feedback, and public speaking. I believe it would help us work better with clients and within the team. Would you be interested in attending together? It's next Wednesday and lasts about three hours. I think it would be a great investment in our professional growth. Let me know if you are keen. I can sign us up if you agree.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором подтвердите, что вы получили его платеж, и сообщите, что работа над его заказом начнется в ближайшее время.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are pleased to confirm that we have received your payment for the order. We will begin working on your project immediately. Our team will keep you updated on the progress regularly. We expect to complete the work within the agreed timeline. If you have any specific requirements or additional instructions, please let us know as soon as possible. We appreciate your trust in us and look forward to delivering high-quality results. Thank you for choosing our services.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите возможные изменения в совместном проекте из-за новых законодательных требований. Предложите адаптировать план.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to bring to your attention some recent legislative changes that may affect our joint project. We might need to adjust our approach to ensure compliance. I suggest we review the project plan and identify any areas that could be impacted. I have already consulted with a legal expert and prepared a summary of the key points. I would appreciate your input on how we can adapt our strategy while maintaining our goals. Let's schedule a call to discuss this in detail. I think it's important to act proactively.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о том, как вы провели свой день рождения. Опишите, с кем были, что делали и что подарили.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I had a wonderful birthday celebration last weekend. I invited a few close friends over for dinner. We had a delicious meal, played board games, and laughed a lot. The best gift I received was a book I've been wanting to read for ages. I also got some lovely flowers and a homemade cake. It was a simple but perfect evening. I felt so grateful for the people in my life. Thank you for your birthday message – it really made me smile. I hope we can meet up soon.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором спросите, можно ли заказать завтрак в номер. Уточните меню и цены.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would like to know if it is possible to order breakfast to my room. Could you please send me the room service menu with prices? I would also like to know the serving hours. I prefer a light breakfast with fruit, yogurt, and coffee. It would be convenient for me to have breakfast in my room on some mornings. Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your reply. I appreciate your help in making my stay more comfortable.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите разрешения на приобретение нового оборудования для вашего отдела. Объясните, как это повысит производительность.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to request permission to purchase new equipment for our department. The current tools are outdated and often slow down our work. Upgrading to newer models would significantly increase our efficiency and reduce downtime. I have prepared a detailed cost-benefit analysis showing that the investment would pay for itself within a year. I have also consulted with our IT team and they confirmed compatibility. I would appreciate your approval. Please let me know if you need any additional information.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором предложите совместно провести исследование рынка для выявления новых трендов. Опишите, как это может помочь вашим бизнесам.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I suggest we collaborate on a market research project to identify emerging trends in our industry. By pooling our resources, we can gain deeper insights and spot opportunities earlier. I believe this would give us a competitive edge and help us innovate. I have already outlined a research methodology and timeline. I would appreciate your input and would like to discuss how we can share the findings. Let me know if you are interested. I think this collaboration could be very fruitful.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором попросите его поделиться своим опытом работы с новым инструментом. Спросите, с какими трудностями он столкнулся и как их преодолел.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi, I heard that you recently started using the new project management tool. I am also planning to adopt it and would love to hear about your experience. What challenges did you face during the transition? How did you overcome them? Any tips on getting the team up to speed? I would really appreciate your advice. It would save me time and help me avoid common mistakes. Let me know when you have a few minutes to chat. Thanks in advance for your help.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором поблагодарите за своевременную оплату и сообщите, что его заказ уже в пути. Предоставьте трек-номер для отслеживания.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, thank you for your prompt payment. We are pleased to inform you that your order has been shipped and is on its way. You can track its progress using the following tracking number: 123456789. The estimated delivery date is within three business days. We hope you will be satisfied with your purchase. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us. We appreciate your business and look forward to serving you again in the future.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите создать программу наставничества для молодых специалистов. Опишите, как это поможет их развитию и удержанию.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to propose introducing a mentoring programme for our junior specialists. Pairing them with experienced employees would accelerate their learning and make them feel more supported. This could improve retention and help us build a stronger talent pipeline. I have seen how effective mentoring can be in fostering professional growth. I would be happy to coordinate the matching process and define the programme structure. I believe this would be a valuable addition to our HR initiatives. I hope you will consider it.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своих планах на саморазвитие в этом году. Опишите, какие навыки вы хотите развить и почему.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I've set some personal development goals for this year. I want to improve my public speaking skills and learn basic coding. I believe these skills will help me in my career and also boost my confidence. I've already started taking online courses and joined a speaking club. It's challenging, but I'm really motivated. I think continuous learning is so important. Do you have any similar goals? Maybe we can motivate each other. Let me know what you think. I would love to hear about your plans too.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором сообщите, что вы планируете продлить проживание на два дня. Уточните, есть ли свободные номера и стоимость.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I am writing to inquire about extending my stay for an additional two nights. I am currently in room 205 and would like to keep it if possible. Could you please confirm if the room is available and what the rate would be? I would also appreciate it if you could let me know the check-out time. I have enjoyed my stay so far and would be happy to stay longer. Please let me know as soon as possible so I can make the necessary arrangements. Thank you for your help.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите возможности совместного обучения ваших команд для улучшения взаимодействия. Предложите конкретные форматы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I believe we could improve our collaboration by organising joint training sessions for our teams. We could have workshops on communication, project management, or even technical skills. This would help our teams understand each other better and work more effectively together. I suggest we start with a half-day session and then evaluate the results. We could also alternate hosting between our locations. What do you think? I am open to any suggestions. Let me know if you are interested in exploring this further.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите разрешения на участие в онлайн-конференции, которая может быть полезна для вашей работы. Объясните, что вы узнаете нового.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to request permission to attend an online conference on digital innovation next month. The conference features experts from our industry and will cover the latest trends and technologies. I believe that the knowledge I gain there would be directly applicable to our current projects and help us stay competitive. The registration fee is reasonable, and I can attend without travelling. I would be happy to share the key takeaways with the team. I hope you will approve my participation.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своём новом музыкальном увлечении. Опишите, как вы начали играть на инструменте и что вам это даёт.
beginner.sample_answer: Hi! I recently started learning to play the guitar, and I'm absolutely loving it. It's challenging but so rewarding. I practice every day for about 30 minutes and I can already play a few simple songs. It's a great way to relax after work and express myself creatively. I've also started writing my own little melodies. I wish I had started earlier! If you ever want to learn an instrument, I highly recommend it. Maybe we could jam together sometime once I get better. Let me know what you think.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором предложите встретиться после долгой разлуки. Используйте сложную лексику, чтобы описать, как вы соскучились и как хотите провести время вместе.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, it feels like an eternity since we last saw each other, and I must confess I have missed our conversations tremendously. I was wondering whether you would be free to meet up this coming weekend, perhaps for a leisurely walk in the park followed by a cup of coffee at that quaint little café we used to frequent. Not only would it be wonderful to catch up properly, but I also believe it would do us both a world of good to escape our hectic routines for a while. Please let me know if this suits you, and we can finalise the details. I sincerely hope you can make it.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите о гибком графике работы на один день. Используйте формальные обороты и инверсию, чтобы обосновать свою просьбу.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to respectfully request a flexible working arrangement for this coming Thursday, as I have a pressing personal matter that requires my attention in the morning. Should you grant this request, I would be more than willing to make up for the lost hours later in the evening and ensure that all my tasks are completed to the usual standard. Not only would this arrangement alleviate a great deal of stress, but it would also allow me to maintain my productivity without compromising my responsibilities. I trust you will consider this proposal favourably and I remain at your disposal for any further clarification.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором извинитесь за задержку и объясните причину. Используйте пассивные конструкции и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we wish to offer our sincere apologies for the delay in delivering your order, which has been caused by unforeseen logistical difficulties beyond our control. Every possible measure has been taken to expedite the process, and we are confident that the shipment will reach you by the end of this week. Had we anticipated these complications, we would have informed you sooner. As a gesture of goodwill, we have arranged a 10% discount on your next purchase. We hope this compensation goes some way towards mitigating any inconvenience you may have experienced, and we greatly appreciate your patience and understanding.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором поблагодарите его за помощь и предложите ответную услугу. Используйте фразовые глаголы и идиомы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I cannot thank you enough for the invaluable support you provided during the recent project. Your insights and willingness to go the extra mile truly made a difference, and I am acutely aware that I could not have pulled it off without you. I would be more than happy to return the favour whenever you find yourself in a tight spot – just say the word, and I will be there. I genuinely appreciate your professionalism and kindness, and I hope we can continue to collaborate on future endeavours. Please do not hesitate to call on me if there is anything I can do for you.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором попросите рекомендовать ресторан. Используйте сложные придаточные и формальный тон.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would be most grateful if you could kindly recommend a reputable restaurant in the vicinity that serves authentic local cuisine, as I am keen to experience the culinary traditions of this region during my stay. Should you have any personal favourites, I would be delighted to hear your suggestions. I have a particular preference for seafood and dishes that are not overly spicy, but I am open to exploring new flavours. I would also appreciate it if the establishment is within walking distance, as I enjoy an evening stroll. Thank you in advance for your kind assistance, and I look forward to your recommendations.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите улучшить коммуникацию в команде. Используйте инверсию и сложные союзы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to propose that we adopt a more structured approach to internal communication, as I believe it would significantly enhance our team's efficiency. Not only would a weekly briefing help clarify priorities, but it would also provide a platform for addressing potential issues before they escalate. Were we to implement such a system, I am confident that misunderstandings would be reduced and collaboration would become more seamless. I have outlined a simple framework that could be trialled for a month without disrupting our current workflow. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss this with you further at your convenience.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором поделитесь новостью о своей поездке. Используйте образные выражения и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, I have just returned from an absolutely unforgettable journey to the Scottish Highlands, and I cannot wait to tell you all about it. Never have I seen landscapes so breathtaking – the rugged mountains, the misty lochs, and the endless green valleys seemed almost surreal. Had I known it would be this spectacular, I would have visited years ago. I spent my days hiking along ancient trails, savouring the crisp air, and immersing myself in the rich local culture. I even managed to learn a few phrases in Gaelic. I truly wish you could have been there to share this adventure with me. We must plan a trip together next time.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором подтвердите получение заказа и сообщите сроки. Используйте пассивные конструкции и формальный стиль.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are pleased to confirm that your order has been received and is now being processed by our dedicated team. The items have been checked for quality, and they will be dispatched within the next two business days. A tracking number will be sent to you via email as soon as the shipment is on its way. Should you require any further information regarding your order, please do not hesitate to contact our customer service department, which is available around the clock. We greatly appreciate your trust in our services and look forward to serving you again in the future. Thank you for choosing us.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором предложите вместе подготовиться к презентации. Используйте фразовые глаголы и деловую лексику.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I was thinking that we could team up to prepare for the upcoming board presentation, as I believe our combined expertise would yield a more compelling and polished outcome. We could divide the work according to our strengths – you could handle the financial projections, while I focus on the market analysis and strategic recommendations. I suggest we meet briefly tomorrow to outline the structure and agree on a timeline. I am confident that by pooling our resources and bouncing ideas off each other, we will deliver a presentation that truly stands out. Let me know what you think.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите разрешения на удалённую работу. Используйте инверсию и сложные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to respectfully request permission to work remotely for one day next week, as I have some personal commitments that would make commuting particularly challenging. Should you grant this request, I assure you that my productivity will not be compromised; I will be fully available via phone and email throughout the day. Not only would this arrangement allow me to manage my responsibilities more effectively, but it would also enable me to complete my tasks without any disruption to the team. I hope you will consider this proposal favourably, and I am happy to discuss it further if you have any concerns.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором предложите совместный вебинар. Используйте сложные союзы и деловую лексику.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to propose that we organise a joint webinar aimed at our shared client base, as I believe this would be an excellent opportunity to showcase our expertise and strengthen our relationship. The topic could be 'Emerging Trends in Digital Transformation', which I know is of great interest to many of our clients. Not only would this allow us to share valuable insights, but it would also position us both as thought leaders in our field. I have already sketched out a rough agenda and would be delighted to collaborate on the content. Please let me know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своей неудаче и попросите совета. Используйте эмоциональную лексику и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, I am writing to you with a heavy heart, as I have recently experienced a significant setback that has left me feeling rather demoralised. Despite my best efforts, my application for the promotion was unsuccessful, and I cannot help but question my abilities and wonder where I went wrong. Had I prepared more thoroughly, perhaps the outcome might have been different. I would greatly appreciate your honest perspective on this matter – do you think I should try again, or would it be wiser to explore other opportunities? Your advice has always been invaluable to me, and I would be grateful for your support during this difficult time.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором пожалуйтесь на неисправность в номере. Используйте пассивные конструкции и формальный тон.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I am writing to bring to your attention a problem with the air conditioning unit in my room, which has been malfunctioning since my arrival. Despite adjusting the settings, the temperature remains uncomfortably high, making it difficult to sleep. I would be grateful if a technician could be sent to inspect and repair the unit as soon as possible. Additionally, the bathroom tap appears to be leaking, which I suspect may waste a considerable amount of water if left unattended. I trust that these issues will be resolved promptly, and I appreciate your assistance in this matter. Thank you for your attention.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите внедрить систему поощрений. Используйте сложные придаточные и аргументацию.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to propose the introduction of a reward system to recognise and incentivise outstanding performance among our employees. Such a scheme, if implemented thoughtfully, could significantly boost morale and encourage a culture of excellence. I believe that acknowledging hard work not only motivates individuals but also fosters a sense of belonging and loyalty, which in turn reduces turnover rates. We could start with monthly recognition awards and perhaps quarterly bonuses for exceptional contributions. I would be happy to work with HR to develop a fair and transparent criteria framework. I look forward to your feedback on this initiative.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите итоги квартала. Используйте деловую лексику и сложные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to share our quarterly performance results with you, as I believe they provide valuable insights into the effectiveness of our joint strategy. Overall, we have seen a 15% increase in revenue, which is largely attributable to the successful launch of our collaborative marketing campaign. However, we have also identified some areas where our operational efficiency could be improved, particularly in supply chain management. I propose that we schedule a meeting to discuss these findings in detail and explore potential adjustments to our approach. I am confident that by working together, we can build on this momentum and achieve even better results in the coming months.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором поблагодарите за поддержку в трудной ситуации. Используйте идиомы и эмоциональную лексику.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering support during the recent challenging period. Your kindness and solidarity meant more to me than words can say, and I genuinely do not know how I would have managed without your encouragement. You went above and beyond to lighten my load, and I am deeply touched by your generosity. I hope that I can repay your kindness someday, and I want you to know that I will always be there for you in return. Thank you for being such a wonderful colleague and friend. I truly appreciate everything you have done.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором предложите скидку за лояльность. Используйте формальные обороты и пассивные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we would like to express our sincere appreciation for your continued loyalty to our company over the years. As a token of our gratitude, we are delighted to offer you an exclusive 15% discount on your next order, which can be applied to any product or service in our catalogue. This offer is valid for the next 30 days and can be combined with other promotions. We hope that this gesture reflects our commitment to rewarding our most valued customers. Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our dedicated support team. We look forward to serving you again soon.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своём новом хобби. Используйте образные выражения и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, I have recently taken up watercolour painting, and I must say it has become an unexpected source of joy and tranquillity in my life. Never before had I realised how therapeutic it could be to watch colours blend on paper and create something beautiful from nothing. I have been experimenting with landscapes and floral motifs, and although my skills are still far from perfect, I find the process incredibly fulfilling. I would love to show you some of my work when we next meet – perhaps you might even be inspired to try it yourself. I would be happy to lend you my spare brushes and paints.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите о повышении зарплаты. Используйте сложные аргументы и убедительную лексику.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to respectfully request a review of my current salary, as I believe my contributions over the past year have significantly exceeded the expectations of my role. I have consistently delivered high-quality results, taken on additional responsibilities, and played a key role in several successful projects. I understand that salary adjustments are subject to various factors, but I am confident that my performance justifies a reconsideration. I would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss this matter with you and to provide any supporting evidence you may require. Thank you for your time and consideration.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором попросите организовать трансфер. Используйте формальные выражения и сложные придаточные.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would be most grateful if you could arrange a transfer from the airport to your hotel for my arrival next Tuesday. My flight is scheduled to land at 6 PM, and I would appreciate it if the driver could wait for me with a sign bearing my name. Should there be any delays, I will notify you as soon as possible. I would also like to know the cost of this service in advance. Additionally, if possible, I would prefer a vehicle that can accommodate two pieces of luggage. Thank you for your kind assistance. I look forward to my stay.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором предложите совместную выставку. Используйте деловую лексику и сложные союзы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to propose that we participate in the upcoming industry trade fair together, as I believe this would significantly enhance our visibility and attract new business opportunities. By sharing a joint stand, we could reduce costs while presenting a unified front that showcases the complementary nature of our products. Not only would this demonstrate our strong partnership, but it would also allow us to engage with a wider audience and generate valuable leads. I have already reserved a prime location, subject to your agreement. Please let me know your thoughts as soon as possible, so we can finalise the arrangements.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором попросите его проверить ваш отчёт. Используйте вежливый тон и сложные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I hope this message finds you well. I would be extremely grateful if you could spare a few minutes to review my draft report before I submit it to the management. Your keen eye for detail and expert knowledge of the subject would be invaluable in identifying any inconsistencies or areas that could be strengthened. I have already double-checked the data and methodology, but I would appreciate your second opinion. Please let me know if you have any suggestions for improvement. I am happy to adjust the document according to your feedback. Thank you in advance for your time and expertise.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите провести опрос сотрудников. Используйте пассивные конструкции и формальный стиль.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to suggest that we conduct an anonymous survey among employees to gather feedback on their workplace satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. Such a survey could be designed to cover aspects such as workload, communication, and professional development opportunities. It is important that employees feel their opinions are heard and valued, and this initiative would demonstrate our commitment to fostering a positive work environment. I have prepared a draft questionnaire that could be adapted as needed. I would be happy to oversee the distribution and analysis of the results. Please let me know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своей новой работе. Используйте образные выражения и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, I have started a new job as a project coordinator at a tech firm, and I must say the experience has been both exhilarating and demanding. Never before have I encountered such a dynamic and fast-paced environment, where every day brings new challenges and opportunities to learn. My colleagues are incredibly supportive and knowledgeable, and I feel I am growing both professionally and personally. I have already been entrusted with leading a small team, which I find both daunting and deeply rewarding. I hope we can catch up soon so I can tell you more about my adventures in the corporate world.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором примите его предложение и обсудите детали. Используйте формальные выражения и сложные союзы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are delighted to accept your proposal and look forward to embarking on this collaboration with enthusiasm. We believe that our combined expertise will yield outstanding results. To ensure a smooth start, we suggest we schedule an initial planning meeting to finalise the timeline, define key milestones, and allocate responsibilities. We have also prepared a draft contract for your review, which outlines the terms and conditions as agreed. Please let us know a convenient time for the meeting. We are eager to begin and are confident that this partnership will be highly successful and mutually beneficial.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите пересмотреть условия работы. Используйте инверсию и убедительную лексику.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to request a review of my current working conditions, as I believe certain adjustments could significantly enhance my productivity and job satisfaction. Should you be open to discussing this, I would like to propose a more flexible schedule that allows me to work remotely two days a week, which I am confident would improve my work-life balance without compromising my output. I understand that such changes require careful consideration, but I am willing to trial this arrangement and provide regular feedback. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss this further at your convenience.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите совместный проект. Используйте деловую лексику и сложные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to take this opportunity to discuss the progress of our joint project and evaluate whether we are on track to meet our objectives. I have reviewed the recent milestones, and while I am pleased with the overall momentum, I believe there are a few areas where we could streamline our processes to enhance efficiency. I would particularly like to address the communication gaps that have occasionally arisen between our teams. I suggest we hold a video conference to align our strategies and agree on any necessary adjustments. Please let me know your availability.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором предложите совместный отдых на выходных. Используйте образные выражения и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, I was thinking that we could escape the city for a weekend getaway to the countryside, as I feel we both need a break from our demanding schedules. Were you to agree, I would suggest we leave on Friday evening and return on Sunday, giving us ample time to unwind and explore the scenic surroundings. I have already found a charming cottage with a fireplace and a lovely garden, which I believe would provide the perfect setting for some quality time together. We could go for long walks, cook hearty meals, and simply enjoy each other's company. Let me know if this appeals to you.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором попросите дополнительное обслуживание номера. Используйте пассивные конструкции и формальный стиль.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would like to request some additional amenities for my room, as I have found the current provisions to be insufficient for my needs. Specifically, I would appreciate it if you could send two extra towels and an extra pillow to my room, as well as a kettle and some herbal tea bags. I have already informed the reception, but I wanted to confirm this request in writing to ensure it is actioned promptly. I hope this does not cause any inconvenience, and I am grateful for your assistance. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите новый подход к решению проблемы. Используйте инверсию и сложные аргументы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to propose an innovative approach to addressing the recurring issue we have been facing with our supply chain. Rather than sticking to our current methods, which have proven inefficient, I suggest we adopt a more flexible model that allows us to adapt quickly to fluctuations in demand. Not only would this improve our responsiveness, but it would also reduce costs in the long term. Had we implemented this earlier, we might have avoided some of the recent delays. I have prepared a detailed plan and would be happy to present it to you at your convenience.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите возможности для расширения бизнеса. Используйте деловую лексику и сложные союзы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I believe we have reached a point where we should seriously consider expanding our business into new markets. Given our recent successes, I am confident that we have the resources and expertise to explore opportunities in the Asian region. I have already conducted some preliminary research and identified a few promising avenues, particularly in the tech sector. However, I would value your input before we proceed further, as your perspective on the potential risks and rewards would be invaluable. Let us schedule a meeting to discuss this in depth.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором попросите его прокомментировать ваш проект. Используйте вежливый тон и сложные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I would be most grateful if you could take a look at my current project and offer your professional opinion. I have been working on this for several weeks, and I feel that an external perspective would help me identify any blind spots or areas for improvement. I particularly value your expertise in this domain, and I trust your judgement implicitly. If you have any suggestions, I would be happy to incorporate them. I understand you have a busy schedule, but even a brief review would be extremely helpful. Thank you in advance for your time.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите разрешения на участие в тренинге. Используйте пассивные конструкции и формальные выражения.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to request your permission to attend a professional training course on advanced data analysis, which is being offered by a reputable institution next month. I believe that this course would significantly enhance my skills and enable me to contribute more effectively to our team's projects. The training is scheduled to take place over three days, and I would be able to manage my workload accordingly. I have attached a detailed outline of the course content for your reference. I would greatly appreciate your approval and look forward to your positive response.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своём недавнем отпуске. Используйте образные выражения и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, I have just returned from a wonderfully relaxing holiday by the sea, and I feel completely rejuvenated. Never before have I experienced such a perfect combination of sunshine, crystal-clear water, and delicious local cuisine. I spent my days swimming, reading on the beach, and exploring charming coastal villages. I even took a boat trip to a nearby island, where I discovered secluded coves and breathtaking views. I wish you could have been there to share this experience with me. I have so many photos to show you when we next meet.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором предложите улучшить его текущий пакет услуг. Используйте формальный тон и сложные союзы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we would like to propose an upgrade to your current service package, which we believe would provide you with added value and enhanced functionality. The new package includes priority support, advanced reporting features, and access to our latest tools, all of which have been designed to streamline your operations. Not only would this upgrade improve your efficiency, but it would also give you a competitive edge in your industry. I have attached a detailed comparison of the features for your convenience. Please let us know if you would like to proceed.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите о дополнительном времени для проекта. Используйте сложные аргументы и убедительную лексику.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to request an extension of the deadline for the current project, as I believe an additional two weeks would allow us to deliver a significantly higher quality result. While we have made substantial progress, I feel that rushing to meet the original timeline would compromise the thoroughness of our analysis. I am confident that with a little more time, we can exceed expectations and produce work that truly reflects our capabilities.
