beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором предложите совместный проект. Используйте вежливый тон и сложные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I have been thinking about a potential project that I believe would benefit greatly from your expertise. I have developed a rough concept that involves integrating new technologies into our current offerings, and I think your insights would be invaluable in refining the approach. I would love to collaborate with you on this and explore the possibilities further. If you are interested, I would be happy to share my initial notes and discuss how we could proceed. Please let me know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором подтвердите получение его запроса. Используйте формальные выражения и пассивные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are pleased to confirm that we have received your request and it is currently being processed by our team. We will carefully review the details and provide you with a comprehensive response within the next two business days. Should you require any further assistance in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us. We appreciate your patience and trust in our services and are committed to delivering a solution that meets your expectations. Thank you for choosing our company.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своей новой диете. Используйте образные выражения и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, I have recently adopted a new diet that has completely transformed my energy levels and overall well-being. I have cut out processed foods and sugar, and I am now focusing on whole, nutrient-rich ingredients. I was sceptical at first, but the results have been remarkable – I feel lighter, more focused, and much healthier. I have even started cooking more creatively, experimenting with flavours and textures I never would have tried before. I would be happy to share some of my favourite recipes with you if you are interested.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите улучшить корпоративную культуру. Используйте инверсию и сложные аргументы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to propose several initiatives to improve our corporate culture and foster a more inclusive and engaging work environment. Not only would regular team-building activities strengthen relationships, but they would also boost morale and creativity. Were we to encourage open communication and recognise individual contributions more visibly, employees might feel more valued and motivated. I have gathered some ideas from my observations and would be happy to present them in more detail. I believe these changes would have a lasting positive impact.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите возможности для совместного обучения. Используйте деловую лексику и сложные союзы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I believe that there are significant opportunities for joint training initiatives that could benefit both our teams and strengthen our collaboration. I was thinking of organising workshops on topics such as cross-cultural communication and project management. By sharing our knowledge and best practices, we could enhance our capabilities and foster a deeper understanding of each other's working styles. I would like to explore this idea further with you and discuss how we could structure such programmes. Please let me know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором попросите его прокомментировать вашу статью. Используйте вежливый тон и сложные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I have written a draft article for an industry journal, and I would be extremely grateful for your honest feedback. I value your expertise and believe that your perspective would help me refine the arguments and improve the overall clarity. I am particularly interested in your thoughts on the structure and the strength of the evidence presented. If you have any suggestions for additional sources or alternative viewpoints, I would be happy to incorporate them. Thank you in advance for your time and assistance.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором попросите информацию о трансфере. Используйте формальные выражения и сложные придаточные.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would be grateful if you could provide me with information about the transfer service from the airport to your hotel. I would like to know the cost, the frequency of departures, and whether I need to book in advance. I am arriving on the evening of July 15 and would prefer a private transfer if possible. Please also let me know where I can find the driver upon arrival. Thank you for your assistance, and I look forward to your reply.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите о дополнительном отпуске. Используйте сложные аргументы и убедительную лексику.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to formally request an additional week of leave, as I believe that taking some time to recharge would significantly enhance my productivity and well-being upon my return. I have been working intensely on several demanding projects over the past few months, and I feel that a short break would allow me to return with renewed energy and focus. I have already made arrangements to ensure that my responsibilities are covered during my absence. I would be grateful for your approval.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своём новом опыте в волонтёрстве. Используйте образные выражения и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, I have recently started volunteering at a local animal shelter, and I must say it has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my life. Not only have I had the chance to care for abandoned animals, but I have also met some truly inspiring people along the way. The sense of fulfilment I get from helping these creatures is indescribable, and it has given me a new perspective on compassion and responsibility. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a meaningful way to give back to the community.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором предложите дополнительную услугу. Используйте пассивные конструкции и формальный тон.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we would like to bring to your attention a new service that has recently been added to our portfolio, which we believe could be of great benefit to you. The service includes priority technical support and customised reporting, designed to save you time and provide deeper insights into your operations. We are confident that this addition would complement your current package effectively. If you are interested, we would be delighted to arrange a demonstration at your convenience. Please let us know your thoughts.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите планы по расширению. Используйте деловую лексику и сложные союзы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to discuss our expansion plans for the upcoming year and explore how we can align our strategies to maximise growth. I have identified several promising markets that I believe we could enter successfully together. However, I also recognise that such expansion requires careful planning and coordination. I suggest we conduct a joint feasibility study to assess the potential risks and rewards. I would welcome your input on this matter and look forward to collaborating on this exciting opportunity.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором предложите совместный обед для обсуждения идей. Используйте вежливый тон и сложные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I was thinking that we could meet for lunch sometime this week to brainstorm some ideas for our upcoming project. I believe that a change of setting might help us think more creatively and approach challenges from a fresh perspective. I have a few concepts in mind that I would like to share with you, and I am eager to hear your thoughts. Please let me know when you are available. I am looking forward to a productive and enjoyable conversation.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите обновить оборудование. Используйте сложные аргументы и убедительную лексику.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to request an update to our department's equipment, as the current tools are outdated and often cause delays. Upgrading to newer models would not only improve our efficiency but also reduce maintenance costs in the long term. I have prepared a cost-benefit analysis that demonstrates the potential return on investment. I am confident that this expenditure would be justified and would significantly enhance our team's performance. I would appreciate your consideration of this request and am happy to provide further details.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо менеджеру отеля, в котором поблагодарите за отличный сервис. Используйте формальные выражения и сложные придаточные.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear Hotel Manager, I would like to express my sincere appreciation for the excellent service I have received during my stay at your hotel. The staff have been exceptionally courteous and attentive, and the facilities are of the highest standard. I was particularly impressed by the cleanliness of my room and the quality of the meals. I am confident that I will return to your hotel in the future and will not hesitate to recommend it to my friends and colleagues. Thank you once again for making my stay so enjoyable.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором обсудите результаты совместного исследования. Используйте деловую лексику и сложные союзы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I have reviewed the results of our joint research project, and I am pleased to say that they are very promising. The data suggests that our hypothesis was correct, and we have gained valuable insights that could inform our future strategies. I believe that we should consider publishing these findings in a reputable journal to enhance our credibility. I would welcome your thoughts on this matter and would like to discuss the next steps. Please let me know when you are available for a meeting.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо другу, в котором расскажите о своём опыте в новом городе. Используйте образные выражения и сложные времена.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear friend, I have now been living in my new city for three months, and I am starting to feel truly at home. Never before have I experienced such a vibrant and diverse community, where every street seems to tell a different story. I have been exploring the local markets, trying new cuisines, and getting to know the neighbourhoods. There is so much to discover, and I feel incredibly fortunate to be here. I hope you can visit me soon so I can show you around and share my favourite spots.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором предложите улучшить систему найма. Используйте пассивные конструкции и формальный стиль.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I would like to suggest that we review and improve our recruitment system to attract and retain top talent more effectively. It has been observed that our current process is lengthy and sometimes fails to identify the most suitable candidates. I propose that we streamline the application stages and incorporate more practical assessments. I believe that these changes would enhance the quality of our hires and reduce time-to-fill. I have prepared a detailed proposal and would be happy to present it to you.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо клиенту, в котором подтвердите отмену заказа. Используйте формальные выражения и пассивные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear client, we are writing to confirm the cancellation of your order, as per your request. The cancellation has been processed successfully, and the refund will be issued to your account within the next five business days. We hope that this resolution meets your expectations and apologise for any inconvenience this may have caused. Should you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us. We value your business and hope to serve you again in the future.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо партнёру, в котором предложите совместный проект по устойчивому развитию. Используйте деловую лексику и сложные союзы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear partner, I would like to propose a joint project focused on sustainability, which I believe would not only benefit our companies but also have a positive impact on the environment. I have been researching innovative ways to reduce our carbon footprint, and I am convinced that our combined expertise could lead to meaningful progress. I suggest we explore initiatives such as waste reduction programmes and renewable energy adoption. I would be delighted to discuss this further and develop a concrete action plan together.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо коллеге, в котором попросите его помочь с презентацией. Используйте вежливый тон и сложные конструкции.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear colleague, I have an important presentation next week, and I would be extremely grateful for your support in preparing it. I know you have a great deal of experience in this area, and I would value your advice on how to structure the content and make it more engaging. I have already drafted some slides, but I would appreciate your feedback on the clarity and flow. If you have any tips on handling difficult questions, I would be very interested to hear them. Thank you in advance for your help.

beginner.task_text: Напишите письмо начальнику, в котором попросите о пересмотре графика работы. Используйте инверсию и сложные аргументы.
beginner.sample_answer: Dear boss, I am writing to request a review of my current work schedule, as I believe that a more flexible arrangement would significantly improve my work-life balance. Not only would this benefit my personal well-being, but it would also enable me to be more productive and focused during my working hours. Were you to consider a shift to a four-day week or compressed hours, I am confident that I could maintain, if not enhance, my current output. I would be happy to trial this arrangement and provide regular updates on its effectiveness.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно заниматься спортом?». Приведите 2 причины и объясните их.
beginner.sample_answer: Sport is very important for our health. It gives us energy and makes us strong. When we do sport, we feel better and happier. I think everyone should exercise every day.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему полезно есть фрукты и овощи?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Fruit and vegetables are very healthy. They give us vitamins and energy. They help us stay strong and not get sick. I always eat an apple and some carrots every day.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы любите делать в свободное время?». Опишите своё хобби.
beginner.sample_answer: In my free time I like to read books. It helps me relax and learn new things. I also enjoy drawing and listening to music. These hobbies make me happy and calm.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно помогать членам семьи?». Приведите 2 аргумента.
beginner.sample_answer: It is important to help family members because it makes life easier for everyone. We can share responsibilities and show care. Helping at home also teaches us to be responsible.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Какое время года вам нравится больше всего и почему?». Объясните свой выбор.
beginner.sample_answer: I like summer most of all. The weather is warm and the sun shines brightly. I can swim in the sea and play outside. Summer makes me feel free and happy.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно читать книги?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Reading books is very important. It helps us learn new words and ideas. When we read, we relax and use our imagination. I think every person should read every day.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы думаете о домашних животных?». Скажите, какое животное вы хотели бы завести и почему.
beginner.sample_answer: I think pets are wonderful. They are loyal and bring us joy. I would like to have a dog because dogs are friendly and like to play. A pet can be a true friend.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно хорошо учиться?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Good study helps us gain knowledge and skills for our future. It opens doors to better jobs and opportunities. Learning new things also makes life more interesting.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы обычно делаете по выходным?». Опишите свой типичный выходной день.
beginner.sample_answer: On weekends I usually spend time with my family. We go to the park or watch a movie together. Sometimes I meet my friends and we play football. I enjoy weekends a lot.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны заботиться о природе?». Приведите 2 аргумента.
beginner.sample_answer: We must take care of nature because it gives us clean air and water. If we pollute it, animals and plants will die. We should plant trees and keep our parks clean.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Какая ваша любимая еда?». Опишите её и объясните, почему она вам нравится.
beginner.sample_answer: My favourite food is pizza. I love it because it has cheese, tomato sauce and many toppings. It is very tasty and I always eat it with my friends. Pizza makes me happy.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно иметь друзей?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Friends are very important in life. They help us when we are sad and share our happy moments. With friends we can have fun and feel less lonely. Everyone needs good friends.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, когда идёт дождь?». Опишите свои занятия.
beginner.sample_answer: When it rains, I like to stay at home. I read a book or watch a film. Sometimes I play board games with my family. Rainy days are cosy and relaxing.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно заботиться о своём здоровье?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Taking care of our health is essential because it helps us avoid diseases and stay active. Good health improves our mood and energy. Regular check-ups and healthy habits keep us strong.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Какое место в вашем городе вам нравится больше всего?». Опишите его.
beginner.sample_answer: My favourite place in my city is the park. There are many trees and flowers there. I can walk, play and relax. The park is beautiful and peaceful.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему полезно рано вставать утром?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Waking up early is good because we have more time to do things. We feel fresh and energetic. We can also have a nice breakfast and plan our day.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы думаете о путешествиях?». Почему люди любят путешествовать?
beginner.sample_answer: Travelling is exciting because we can see new places and meet new people. We learn about different cultures and traditions. It is a great adventure and everyone enjoys it.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны соблюдать правила безопасности на дороге?». Объясните важность.
beginner.sample_answer: We must follow safety rules on the road to protect ourselves and others. Rules prevent accidents and save lives. Everyone should cross streets carefully and obey traffic lights.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Какое ваше любимое время года?». Объясните свой выбор.
beginner.sample_answer: My favourite season is summer. The weather is hot and sunny. I can swim in the sea and eat ice cream. Summer holidays are the best.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны беречь воду?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Water is precious and we must not waste it. Many places have no clean water to drink. We need water for drinking, cooking and washing. We should turn off taps carefully.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, чтобы помочь своей семье?». Опишите свои обязанности.
beginner.sample_answer: I help my family by cleaning my room and washing the dishes. I also help my parents with shopping. I want to be a good and helpful person.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно слушать наставления опытных людей?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Listening to experienced people helps us learn faster and avoid mistakes. They have practical knowledge we can't get from books. Their advice can guide us in career and life.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы любите делать на каникулах?». Опишите свои любимые занятия.
beginner.sample_answer: On holidays I like to travel with my family. We visit new cities and see interesting places. I also enjoy sleeping late and reading books. Holidays are always fun.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему полезно быть добрым и улыбаться?». Объясните важность.
beginner.sample_answer: Smiling and being kind is important because it makes others happy too. When we are kind, people like us more. A smile can brighten someone's day.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Какая ваша любимая книга?». Опишите её кратко.
beginner.sample_answer: My favourite book is 'The Adventures of Tom Sawyer'. It is about a boy who has many exciting adventures. I like the hero because he is brave and clever.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны спать по 8 часов?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Sleep is very important for our health. We need 8 hours of sleep to feel rested. Good sleep gives us energy and helps us concentrate at school.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы обычно едите на завтрак?». Опишите свой завтрак.
beginner.sample_answer: I usually eat cereal with milk for breakfast. I also have a piece of fruit and a glass of juice. Breakfast gives me energy for the whole day.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны заботиться о животных?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: We must take care of animals because they are part of our world. Animals feel pain and need our help. We should not hurt them and we should protect their homes.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, чтобы быть здоровым?». Опишите свои привычки.
beginner.sample_answer: To stay healthy, I eat fruit and vegetables every day. I also exercise and drink lots of water. I try to sleep early and wash my hands often.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно быть вежливым?». Приведите 2 аргумента.
beginner.sample_answer: Being polite is important because it shows respect for others. People like to be treated kindly. A polite person makes the world a nicer place.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы любите делать в воскресенье?». Опишите свой день.
beginner.sample_answer: On Sunday I like to rest and spend time with my family. We often go for a walk or watch a movie. Sometimes we visit our grandparents. Sunday is a relaxing day.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны учить иностранный язык?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Learning a foreign language helps us communicate with people from other countries. It also makes travelling easier and more enjoyable. Knowing a second language opens many doors.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы думаете о компьютерах?». Какие польза и вред?
beginner.sample_answer: Computers are very useful. We can study, work and watch films. But we should not spend too much time on them because it is bad for our eyes and health.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно уметь работать в команде?». Приведите 2 аргумента.
beginner.sample_answer: Working in a team is important because we can share ideas and help each other. Together we can achieve more than alone. Teamwork teaches us to cooperate.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Какая музыка вам нравится?». Опишите свои предпочтения.
beginner.sample_answer: I like pop music because it is energetic and cheerful. I often listen to it when I am happy. Music helps me relax and makes my day better.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно поддерживать порядок в доме?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Keeping our home tidy helps reduce stress and saves time when we look for things. An organised home also makes us feel calm and in control. It is a good habit for a comfortable life.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы любите делать для поддержания физической формы?». Опишите свои любимые упражнения.
beginner.sample_answer: I like running and doing stretching exercises to keep fit. They make me feel energetic and strong. I also enjoy cycling at weekends.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны прислушиваться к советам старших?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Older people have more life experience and can offer useful advice. They want to help us avoid mistakes. Listening to them helps us grow and make better decisions.

beginner.sample_answer: We should take care of our things because they cost money. Being responsible saves us from losing or breaking them. It also shows that we respect what we have.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, когда скучно?». Как вы развлекаетесь?
beginner.sample_answer: When I am bored, I call my friends or play a game. I also like to draw or read a comic book. There are many ways to have fun and not feel bored.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны есть завтрак?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day. It gives us energy to start the day. A healthy breakfast helps us concentrate at school.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Какие качества вы цените в людях?». Опишите их.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны быть вежливыми в интернете?». Приведите 2 аргумента.
beginner.sample_answer: We should be polite online because our words affect others. Being kind prevents cyberbullying. Respectful communication makes the internet a better place.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы любите делать в парке?». Опишите свои любимые занятия.
beginner.sample_answer: I love going to the park to walk and enjoy nature. I play on the swings and feed the ducks. The park is peaceful and makes me feel calm.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны читать перед сном?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Reading before sleep helps us relax and forget about the day. It is a good habit that improves sleep quality. It also increases our knowledge.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы думаете о летних каникулах?». Почему они важны?
beginner.sample_answer: Summer holidays are great because we can rest and have fun. We spend time with family and friends. It is a good break from school and studies.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны мыть овощи и фрукты перед едой?». Объясните важность.
beginner.sample_answer: We must wash fruits and vegetables to remove dirt and germs. Clean food is safe to eat. Washing them prevents stomach problems.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы любите делать в свободное время?». Опишите своё хобби.
beginner.sample_answer: In my free time I like playing football. It is exciting and keeps me fit. I also enjoy listening to music. These activities make me happy.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно быть организованным в учёбе?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Being organised in studies helps us save time and reduce stress. We can plan our homework and revision. Good organisation leads to better grades.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, чтобы помогать природе?». Опишите свои действия.
beginner.sample_answer: I help nature by recycling plastic and paper. I also plant trees in my garden. I never throw rubbish on the ground. Little actions make a big difference.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно общаться с семьёй?». Приведите 2 аргумента.
beginner.sample_answer: Communication with family is important because it builds love and trust. Sharing our feelings makes us closer. It also helps us support each other.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы думаете о рабочей одежде?». Должна ли она быть строгой?
beginner.sample_answer: Work clothes should be practical and appropriate for the job. In some professions, a strict dress code is necessary for safety. In others, comfort is more important.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно делать зарядку по утрам?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Morning exercises give us energy for the day. They make our body strong and healthy. A few minutes of exercise can improve our mood.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Какое ваше любимое время года для прогулок?». Объясните почему.
beginner.sample_answer: I like autumn for walks because the weather is cool and the leaves are colourful. It is not too hot or cold. Autumn walks are peaceful and beautiful.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно быть внимательным на работе?». Приведите 2 аргумента.
beginner.sample_answer: Being attentive at work helps us avoid mistakes and be more efficient. It also shows professionalism. Good attention to detail leads to better results.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы думаете о книгах?». Почему они важны?
beginner.sample_answer: Books are very important because they give us knowledge and ideas. They also develop our imagination. Reading is a useful and enjoyable habit.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны уважать чужое мнение?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: We should respect others' opinions because everyone sees things differently. Listening to different views helps us understand each other. It promotes tolerance and peace.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, когда идёт снег?». Опишите свои занятия.
beginner.sample_answer: When it snows, I love to go outside and play. I make snowmen and have snowball fights. The snow makes everything look beautiful and white.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны заботиться о зубах?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: We must brush our teeth to keep them clean and avoid cavities. Healthy teeth help us eat well and speak clearly. Good dental care is essential.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы любите делать с друзьями?». Опишите свои любимые занятия.
beginner.sample_answer: I love playing football and cycling with my friends. We also chat and tell jokes. Spending time with friends is always fun and exciting.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны слушать советы родителей?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Parents give us good advice because they want the best for us. They have more experience. Listening to them helps us avoid mistakes.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, чтобы быть здоровым?». Опишите свои привычки.
beginner.sample_answer: To be healthy, I exercise every day and eat lots of fruit. I also drink plenty of water. I avoid eating too much sugar. These habits keep me fit.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны быть организованными?». Приведите 2 аргумента.
beginner.sample_answer: Being organised helps us use our time wisely. We can find things quickly and avoid stress. An organised person is more productive.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы любите делать после работы или учёбы?». Опишите свои занятия.
beginner.sample_answer: After work, I usually rest for a while and then do some exercise. I spend time with my family and sometimes read. Evenings are for relaxation.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно уметь слушать других?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Listening to others helps us understand their point of view. It builds trust and respect in relationships. Good listeners are better communicators.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно распределять обязанности в семье?». Приведите 2 аргумента.
beginner.sample_answer: Sharing family responsibilities helps everyone feel involved and valued. It also makes the workload lighter. Cooperation at home strengthens bonds.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны заботиться о растениях?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Plants are important because they give us oxygen and food. We must water them and give them sunlight. Healthy plants make our planet beautiful.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, чтобы хорошо провести время?». Опишите свои любимые развлечения.
beginner.sample_answer: I have fun by playing sports and spending time with my family. I also enjoy watching films and listening to music. Good times are important for happiness.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему важно держать вещи в порядке?». Объясните важность.
beginner.sample_answer: Keeping things tidy helps us save time and avoid stress. When everything is organised, we can find things easily. It is a good habit for a calm life.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы думаете о сладостях?». Любите ли вы их?
beginner.sample_answer: I love sweets, especially chocolate. They make me happy. However, we should eat them in moderation because too much sugar is unhealthy.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны слушать музыку?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Listening to music helps us relax and improves our mood. It can also give us energy. Music is a wonderful way to express feelings.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, когда вы злы?». Как вы справляетесь?
beginner.sample_answer: When I feel angry, I take deep breaths and count to ten. Sometimes I go for a walk to calm down. It helps me think clearly.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны уметь прощать?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: Forgiving others helps us feel peace and avoid anger. It improves relationships and makes life easier. Holding grudges only hurts us.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы думаете о дистанционном обучении?». Какие плюсы и минусы?
beginner.sample_answer: Online learning is convenient because we can study from home. But we need to be self-disciplined. It can be hard to stay focused without a teacher.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны помогать пожилым людям?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: We should help elderly people because they need our support. They are often alone. Helping them shows respect and kindness.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Что вы делаете, когда у вас выходной?». Опишите свой идеальный день.
beginner.sample_answer: On my day off, I like to sleep late and have a big breakfast. Then I go out with my friends or watch a film. I enjoy relaxing and doing nothing.

beginner.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (3–4 предложения) на тему: «Почему мы должны заботиться о своей планете?». Приведите 2 причины.
beginner.sample_answer: We must take care of our planet because it is our home. We want a clean future for ourselves. Recycling and saving energy help protect the Earth.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как технологии изменили способ общения между людьми?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента с примерами.
intermediate.sample_answer: Technology has drastically transformed the way we interact with each other. On one hand, social media platforms allow us to stay connected with friends and family across the globe instantly. For instance, video calls help maintain relationships despite long distances. On the other hand, excessive screen time can reduce face-to-face communication and weaken personal bonds. Overall, while technology offers convenience, it is important to find a balance between online and offline interactions.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему онлайн-образование становится всё более популярным?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
intermediate.sample_answer: Online education has gained significant popularity due to its flexibility and accessibility. Students can study at their own pace and from any location, which is especially useful for those with busy schedules. Moreover, digital platforms offer a wide range of courses that might not be available locally. However, it also requires self-discipline and motivation to succeed. Overall, online education is a convenient alternative to traditional learning.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно изучать историю?». Приведите 2–3 причины.
intermediate.sample_answer: Learning history is crucial for understanding our present and shaping our future. It helps us avoid repeating past mistakes and appreciate the progress we have made. Additionally, history fosters a sense of identity and cultural awareness. By studying different periods, we can better understand the origins of modern social and political systems. In short, history provides essential lessons for living in today's world.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как путешествия расширяют кругозор?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
intermediate.sample_answer: Travelling exposes us to different cultures, traditions, and ways of thinking. It challenges our assumptions and broadens our understanding of the world. For example, visiting a foreign country can teach us about local cuisine, history, and social norms. Moreover, meeting people from diverse backgrounds enhances our empathy and tolerance. Overall, travel is a powerful tool for personal growth and global awareness.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Влияет ли спорт на психическое здоровье?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
intermediate.sample_answer: Regular physical activity has a positive effect on mental health. It helps reduce stress and anxiety by releasing endorphins, which improve mood. Sport also provides a sense of accomplishment and boosts self-esteem. Furthermore, group activities like team sports can reduce feelings of loneliness and foster social connections. Thus, incorporating exercise into daily life is beneficial for both mind and body.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему защита окружающей среды важна?». Приведите 2–3 причины.
intermediate.sample_answer: Protecting the environment is essential for the survival of all living beings. Pollution and deforestation harm ecosystems and contribute to climate change. By adopting sustainable practices, such as recycling and reducing waste, we can slow down environmental degradation. Moreover, a healthy environment ensures clean air, water, and food for future generations. Therefore, environmental protection should be a global priority.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему книги остаются актуальными в эпоху цифровых технологий?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
intermediate.sample_answer: Despite the rise of digital media, books continue to play a vital role in our lives. They offer deep, immersive experiences that screens often cannot replicate. Reading improves concentration, vocabulary, and critical thinking skills. Additionally, books provide a break from screen time and allow for relaxation. In short, books remain an invaluable source of knowledge and entertainment.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как сохранить культурное разнообразие в глобализирующемся мире?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Governments and communities can also protect heritage sites and promote cultural events. By valuing diversity, we can create a richer, more inclusive global society.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему чтение важно для развития критического мышления?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Moreover, reading helps us identify biases and false information. Thus, regular reading is fundamental to developing sharp analytical skills.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как социальные сети влияют на самооценку?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно заботиться о природе?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как искусство помогает в образовании?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как технологии помогают в медицине?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему дружба важна в жизни человека?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

In essence, friends enrich our lives and make us feel connected.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как путешествия помогают в профессиональном росте?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно быть ответственным?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как стресс влияет на учёбу?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

A balanced approach to studies helps maintain mental well-being.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как семья влияет на становление личности?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как экологические привычки могут изменить мир?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Therefore, individual habits collectively shape the future of our planet.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему спорт важен для долголетия?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как интернет влияет на политику?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно быть толерантным?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

Therefore, fostering tolerance is key to building inclusive and harmonious communities.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как книги формируют мировоззрение?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Through fiction, we can experience lives different from our own, fostering empathy. Non-fiction provides factual knowledge that informs our opinions. Thus, reading is crucial for developing a well-rounded and open-minded outlook.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как технологии влияют на творчество и искусство?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Digital painting, animation, and music production offer endless possibilities for expression. It also allows for global sharing and collaboration among artists. However, it may lead to a reliance on technology that sometimes diminishes traditional skills. Nevertheless, technology continues to inspire new forms of artistic expression.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно развивать личный бренд в карьере?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

It communicates your values, skills, and expertise to potential employers or clients. A strong personal brand builds trust and credibility, leading to more opportunities. It also allows you to control your professional narrative and network effectively. Hence, investing in personal branding is essential for career advancement.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как путешествия помогают бороться со стрессом?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
intermediate.sample_answer: Travel is an effective way to reduce stress by providing a break from routine and daily pressures. New environments and experiences distract the mind and promote relaxation. Engaging in enjoyable activities, such as sightseeing or trying new foods, boosts mood and lowers cortisol levels. Additionally, travel offers a fresh perspective on life, helping to put problems into context. Therefore, it is a valuable tool for mental well-being.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно развивать критическое мышление в век информации?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

It enables individuals to distinguish between reliable and unreliable sources, combating misinformation. It also fosters informed decision-making and problem-solving skills. Moreover, critical thinking encourages curiosity and lifelong learning. Thus, it is a fundamental skill for modern citizenship.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как волонтёры помогают в кризисных ситуациях?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

They assist in rescue efforts, distribute supplies, and offer emotional comfort to victims. Their flexibility and local knowledge often complement professional emergency services. Moreover, volunteers help rebuild communities in the aftermath of disasters. Therefore, volunteerism is a vital component of disaster response and recovery.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как социальные сети влияют на политическую активность?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

It allows for rapid dissemination of information and mobilisation of supporters. Online campaigns can influence public opinion and pressure governments. However, it can also spread misinformation and create echo chambers. Despite these drawbacks, social media remains a key platform for civic engagement.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему образование важно для будущего?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

It equips individuals with knowledge and skills needed for the workforce, reducing poverty and inequality. An educated population drives innovation and economic growth. Moreover, education promotes critical thinking and informed citizenship, which are essential for democracy. Therefore, investing in education is investing in a better future.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как музыка помогает в учёбе?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Background instrumental music, especially classical, can create a calm learning environment. It also helps to reduce anxiety and boost mood during long study sessions. However, loud or lyrical music may be distracting. Thus, selecting the right type of music is important for academic success.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно сохранять традиции?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

Celebrating traditions also enriches life with meaning and belonging. In a rapidly changing world, traditions serve as anchors. Therefore, maintaining traditions is vital for cultural preservation and individual well-being.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как спорт развивает дисциплину?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Athletes must follow training schedules and push through challenges, which builds self-control and determination. The commitment to improvement in sport translates to other areas of life. intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как технологии упрощают жизнь?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важна личная гигиена для здоровья?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как путешествия влияют на толерантность?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно быть целеустремлённым?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Какую роль играет семья в поддержке образования?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как экология связана с экономикой?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Green technologies and sustainable practices can create new jobs and industries. Thus, environmental protection is economically beneficial.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему улыбка и хорошее настроение важны?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

Therefore, cultivating a cheerful disposition is beneficial for a fulfilling life.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как интернет влияет на книжную индустрию?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно заниматься саморазвитием?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Какую роль играет наставничество в карьере?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

It also facilitates skill transfer and career progression. Therefore, seeking mentorship is highly beneficial for career advancement.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как волонтёрство помогает в поиске работы?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Volunteers also expand their professional networks, which may lead to job referrals. Moreover, it can fill gaps in a CV and show passion for a cause. Thus, volunteering is a strategic way to boost employability.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему командная работа важна в спорте?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Effective communication and trust among teammates lead to better coordination and performance. Shared goals foster unity and collective effort. Moreover, teamwork teaches individuals to support each other and overcome setbacks together. Hence, it is essential for both success and personal development in sports.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как социальные сети влияют на дружбу?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

However, it can also lead to superficial interactions and reduced quality time. Sometimes online conflicts arise more easily. Balancing online and offline communication is key to preserving meaningful friendships.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно быть честным с самим собой?». Приведите 2–3 причины.

Self-honesty prevents self-deception and reduces internal conflict. It also fosters integrity and authentic relationships with others. Ultimately, it leads to a more fulfilling and aligned life.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Какую роль играет учитель в жизни ученика?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

A good teacher can spark a lifelong love for learning and boost confidence. They also serve as role models and offer support during difficult times. Thus, teachers are instrumental in forming the next generation.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Как технологии влияют на культуру?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Digital platforms have democratised content creation, allowing diverse voices to be heard. However, they can also lead to cultural homogenisation and the loss of local traditions. Social media influences trends and public discourse. Therefore, technology both enriches and challenges cultural diversity.

intermediate.task_text: Напишите короткое эссе (4–6 предложений) на тему: «Почему здоровое питание важно для долголетия?». Приведите 2–3 причины.
intermediate.sample_answer: A healthy diet is a cornerstone of longevity and quality of life in old age. Nutrient-rich foods provide the body with essential vitamins and minerals that support immune function and cellular repair. Consuming balanced meals reduces the risk of chronic diseases like diabetes and heart disease. It also helps maintain a healthy weight and mental agility. Thus, lifelong healthy eating habits promote a longer, healthier life.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Влияет ли интернет на качество межличностных отношений?». Приведите аргументы за и против, используйте сложные связки и формальную лексику.
expert.sample_answer: The internet has undeniably revolutionised the way we interact, offering unprecedented convenience and connectivity. On the one hand, it enables us to maintain relationships across vast distances and provides a platform for sharing experiences. However, critics argue that digital communication often lacks the nuance and emotional depth of face-to-face interaction, which can lead to misunderstandings and a sense of isolation. Furthermore, excessive screen time may erode our ability to empathise with others. Nevertheless, when used judiciously, technology can complement, rather than replace, genuine human connection. Ultimately, the impact of the internet on relationships depends largely on how we choose to integrate it into our lives.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Должны ли люди ограничивать использование социальных сетей?». Приведите аргументы за и против.
expert.sample_answer: The question of whether individuals should limit their social media usage has become increasingly pertinent in recent years. Proponents of restriction argue that excessive scrolling can lead to anxiety, depression, and a distorted perception of reality, as users constantly compare themselves to curated online personas. Conversely, others contend that social media serves as a vital tool for networking, self-expression, and staying informed about global events. Nevertheless, striking a balance is essential, as moderation allows one to reap the benefits while mitigating the potential harms. In my view, setting conscious boundaries is a prudent approach to maintaining both mental well-being and meaningful real-world connections.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему люди стремятся к самосовершенствованию?». Используйте сложные конструкции и формальную лексику.
expert.sample_answer: The pursuit of self-improvement is a fundamental aspect of human nature, driven by an innate desire for growth and fulfilment. Many individuals are motivated by the aspiration to reach their full potential, whether in their careers, personal relationships, or intellectual endeavours. Moreover, the rapid pace of modern life necessitates continuous adaptation, compelling people to acquire new skills and knowledge. However, this quest is not solely external; it often stems from an internal yearning for purpose and meaning. Consequently, self-improvement serves as both a response to societal pressures and a deeply personal journey toward a more satisfying existence.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как музыка влияет на эмоциональное состояние человека?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
expert.sample_answer: Music exerts a profound influence on human emotions, often serving as a powerful tool for mood regulation. Upbeat rhythms can elevate energy levels and foster feelings of joy, whereas melancholic melodies may provide solace during times of sadness. Furthermore, listening to music has been shown to reduce cortisol levels, thereby alleviating stress and promoting relaxation. On a deeper level, music facilitates emotional expression and can evoke vivid memories, connecting us to past experiences. Thus, its impact is both physiological and psychological, making it an invaluable companion in our daily lives.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Следует ли запретить одноразовый пластик?». Приведите аргументы за и против.
expert.sample_answer: The debate over banning single-use plastics has intensified as environmental concerns continue to mount. Advocates argue that such a prohibition is imperative to combat the escalating pollution of our oceans and landscapes, as these materials take centuries to decompose. Moreover, the production of plastic contributes significantly to carbon emissions, exacerbating climate change. On the other hand, opponents contend that a blanket ban could disrupt industries and limit consumer convenience, particularly in developing nations. Nevertheless, the development of sustainable alternatives suggests that a gradual transition is both feasible and necessary. Ultimately, the long-term health of our planet should take precedence over short-term convenience.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно сохранять историческое наследие?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
expert.sample_answer: The preservation of historical heritage is essential for maintaining a sense of collective identity and cultural continuity. Monuments, artifacts, and traditions serve as tangible links to our past, offering invaluable insights into the evolution of societies. Furthermore, historical sites contribute to education and tourism, fostering economic development while enriching our understanding of human achievement. Without deliberate conservation efforts, we risk losing irreplaceable knowledge and cultural diversity. Thus, safeguarding heritage is not merely an act of nostalgia but a responsibility toward future generations.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как стресс влияет на здоровье человека?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Chronic stress can compromise the immune system, making individuals more susceptible to infections and illnesses. Moreover, it is a known contributor to cardiovascular diseases, hypertension, and digestive disorders. Psychologically, prolonged stress can lead to anxiety, depression, and cognitive decline. However, adopting effective coping mechanisms, such as exercise and mindfulness, can mitigate these risks. Therefore, managing stress is crucial for maintaining both physical and mental well-being.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Влияет ли реклама на выбор потребителей?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

However, critics argue that this influence can border on manipulation, encouraging unnecessary consumption and fostering materialism. Nevertheless, consumers are not entirely passive; awareness and media literacy can mitigate the effects of advertising. Ultimately, the extent of its influence depends on the consumer's critical engagement with marketing messages.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как книги помогают в развитии личности?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Moreover, literature fosters empathy by allowing readers to experience life through the eyes of others, cultivating compassion and emotional intelligence. Additionally, engaging with complex narratives enhances critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Thus, the habit of reading is an invaluable tool for intellectual and emotional growth.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Должно ли образование быть бесплатным?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

Moreover, an educated population drives innovation and economic growth, benefiting society as a whole. However, critics contend that free education places a significant burden on taxpayers and may compromise quality due to limited resources. Nevertheless, many countries have demonstrated that well-funded public education systems can achieve excellence. Ultimately, the investment in free education is an investment in a more equitable and prosperous future.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как путешествия влияют на мировоззрение?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно развивать критическое мышление?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

It promotes objectivity by encouraging the examination of issues from multiple perspectives, reducing the influence of bias. Furthermore, critical thinkers are better equipped to identify logical fallacies and distinguish fact from opinion, which is essential for informed citizenship. This skill also enhances problem-solving abilities in professional and personal contexts. Therefore, fostering critical thinking is essential for navigating the complexities of modern life.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Влияет ли мода на самооценку человека?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

On the other hand, fashion serves as a powerful medium for self-expression, allowing people to convey their personality without words. Consequently, while fashion can enhance self-image, it is important to engage with it mindfully and not let external expectations define one's worth.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Должны ли города быть экологичными?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Green infrastructure, such as parks and green roofs, mitigates pollution and reduces the urban heat island effect. Moreover, sustainable transport systems, including cycling lanes and electric public transit, lower carbon emissions and improve air quality. Additionally, eco-conscious urban planning promotes healthier lifestyles by encouraging walking and outdoor activities. Thus, investing in environmentally friendly cities enhances both ecological resilience and the well-being of residents.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как видеоигры влияют на развитие детей?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

On one hand, certain games can enhance cognitive skills, such as problem-solving, spatial awareness, and hand-eye coordination. They can also foster creativity and strategic thinking. On the other hand, excessive gaming is associated with sedentary behaviour, sleep disturbances, and, in some cases, increased aggression. Moreover, the addictive nature of some games can detract from academic and social activities. Therefore, moderation and parental guidance are essential to harnessing the benefits while mitigating potential harms.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно уметь прощать?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
expert.sample_answer: Forgiveness is a powerful act that liberates individuals from the burden of resentment and promotes emotional healing. Holding onto grudges can lead to chronic stress, anxiety, and even physical health issues. By forgiving, we release negative emotions and create space for compassion and understanding. Moreover, forgiveness is essential for repairing and strengthening relationships, as it fosters trust and mutual respect. Ultimately, the ability to forgive is not a sign of weakness but a testament to emotional resilience and maturity.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как технологии меняют рынок труда?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Automation and artificial intelligence are displacing routine jobs while simultaneously generating demand for new skills in data analysis, programming, and digital communication. Consequently, workers must engage in lifelong learning to remain competitive. Furthermore, remote work has become more prevalent, offering flexibility but also blurring the boundaries between professional and personal life. Thus, adapting to technological change is essential for career resilience and economic participation.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно быть благодарным?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
expert.sample_answer: Gratitude is a simple yet profound practice that significantly enhances emotional well-being and life satisfaction. Acknowledging the positive aspects of life shifts focus away from deficiencies and fosters a sense of abundance. Moreover, expressing gratitude strengthens interpersonal relationships by reinforcing mutual appreciation and trust. Psychologically, grateful individuals tend to experience lower levels of stress and depression. Thus, cultivating gratitude is a valuable habit that enriches both personal happiness and social connections.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Следует ли ограничивать использование смартфонов среди молодёжи?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

Conversely, smartphones offer educational resources, facilitate communication with peers, and provide access to vital information. Therefore, rather than imposing blanket bans, a balanced approach that promotes digital literacy and self-regulation may be more effective in mitigating the negative effects while preserving the benefits.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как спорт влияет на характер человека?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

The discipline required to train regularly fosters perseverance and a strong work ethic. Moreover, dealing with both victory and defeat cultivates resilience and humility. Team sports, in particular, teach cooperation, communication, and accountability to others. Consequently, the lessons learned through sport extend far beyond the playing field, contributing to personal and professional success.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Должны ли книги быть цифровыми?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

However, many readers argue that the tactile experience of a physical book cannot be replicated, and prolonged screen time can cause eye strain. Additionally, digital formats raise concerns about ownership and digital rights. Ultimately, the choice between digital and print should be a matter of personal preference.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно иметь хобби?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Какую роль играют музеи в современном обществе?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

They serve as educational resources, offering immersive learning experiences that complement formal education. Moreover, museums stimulate community engagement by hosting exhibitions, workshops, and public events that foster dialogue and cultural exchange. Additionally, they contribute to local economies through tourism. In an era of rapid change, museums remain anchors of collective memory and facilitators of cultural understanding.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Влияет ли телевидение на общественное мнение?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

Through news programmes and documentaries, it informs citizens about current events and political developments. On the other hand, television also provides a platform for diverse voices and critical debate. expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно учиться на протяжении всей жизни?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
expert.sample_answer: Lifelong learning is crucial in an ever-evolving world where knowledge and technology rapidly advance. It enables individuals to adapt to changes in the workplace, acquire new skills, and remain competitive. Moreover, continuous learning fosters intellectual curiosity and personal growth, enhancing overall life satisfaction. It also promotes cognitive health by keeping the mind active and engaged. Therefore, embracing lifelong learning is not just a professional necessity but a pathway to a fulfilling and enriched life.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как социальные сети влияют на политическую активность?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Despite these challenges, social media remains an accessible and influential tool for civic engagement, particularly among younger generations. Thus, it is essential to use these platforms responsibly to foster informed and constructive political participation.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно сохранять культурное разнообразие?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Moreover, diverse cultures contribute to innovation and creativity by offering alternative ways of thinking. Therefore, safeguarding cultural heritage is both a moral imperative and a strategic investment in global harmony.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Какую роль играет учитель в формировании личности ученика?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Consequently, the impact of a dedicated teacher is profound and enduring, affecting not only academic success but also personal and social development.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как наука улучшает качество жизни?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Innovations in agriculture and renewable energy have enhanced food security and mitigated climate change. Moreover, scientific research drives economic growth by fostering new industries and creating jobs. Thus, science is an indispensable driver of human progress and well-being.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно быть экологически ответственным?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Moreover, sustainable practices ensure the availability of natural resources for future generations. Environmental stewardship also fosters a healthier and more resilient society by reducing pollution and protecting biodiversity. Therefore, adopting eco-friendly habits is an essential component of responsible citizenship.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как искусство выражает социальные проблемы?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
expert.sample_answer: Art has long served as a mirror to society, reflecting and challenging social norms and injustices. Thus, art is an essential medium for raising awareness and fostering collective action.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Каковы преимущества и недостатки удалённой работы?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно уметь слушать других?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как экологические проблемы влияют на глобальную экономику?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Conversely, the transition to green technologies presents economic opportunities, creating new industries and jobs. Governments and businesses are increasingly recognising that sustainable practices are not only ethically sound but also economically advantageous. Therefore, addressing environmental challenges is both an ecological and an economic imperative.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Какую роль играет семья в формировании личности?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Thus, the family environment lays the foundation for a person's future interactions and worldview.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как путешествия влияют на личностный рост?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Navigating foreign environments enhances adaptability, problem-solving skills, and self-confidence. Travel also encourages reflection, offering a break from routine and allowing for personal introspection. Thus, it is a transformative experience that enriches one's character and view of the world.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно развивать эмоциональный интеллект?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

High emotional intelligence fosters better communication, reduces conflict, and strengthens relationships. It also enhances leadership skills and decision-making by allowing individuals to navigate complex social dynamics with empathy and clarity. Developing this skill set is essential for thriving in collaborative environments and achieving long-term fulfillment.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Должны ли животные содержаться в зоопарках?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

Proponents argue that zoos play a crucial role in protecting endangered species through breeding programmes and research, while also offering educational opportunities for the public. However, critics contend that captivity can cause psychological distress and limit natural behaviours, even in well-managed facilities. Modern zoos are increasingly focusing on enrichment and habitat replication to improve animal welfare. Ultimately, the ethical justification for zoos depends on their commitment to conservation and the well-being of the animals in their care.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как музыка объединяет людей?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

It serves as a universal language that can evoke powerful feelings and bring people together in celebration, mourning, or protest. Festivals and concerts gather diverse audiences, fostering a sense of community and collective joy. Moreover, music often reflects and reinforces cultural identity, strengthening bonds within communities. Thus, it is a potent force for social cohesion and mutual understanding.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Каковы плюсы и минусы глобализации?». Приведите аргументы за и против.
expert.sample_answer: Globalisation is a multifaceted phenomenon that has reshaped economies, cultures, and societies worldwide. On the positive side, it facilitates the exchange of goods, services, and ideas, fostering economic growth and cultural exchange. It has lifted millions out of poverty by creating new markets and job opportunities. However, globalisation also contributes to cultural homogenisation, environmental degradation, and economic inequality, as wealth and resources are often concentrated in the hands of a few. Additionally, the increased interdependence of nations can amplify systemic risks. Thus, managing the effects of globalisation requires careful policy and international cooperation.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Какую роль играют традиции в современном мире?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

However, as societies evolve, some traditions may become outdated or conflict with contemporary values, necessitating adaptation. While traditions can resist change, they can also be reinterpreted to remain relevant, balancing stability with progress. Ultimately, traditions shape identity and contribute to the richness of cultural diversity.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как искусственный интеллект изменит повседневную жизнь?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

However, the integration of AI raises significant privacy concerns and may lead to job displacement in certain sectors. Additionally, reliance on AI could reduce human interaction and critical thinking. Therefore, a balanced approach that maximises benefits while addressing ethical challenges is essential.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно уметь работать в команде?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

In today's interconnected world, the ability to collaborate is highly valued across all sectors.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как чтение влияет на уровень интеллекта?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Thus, regular reading is a powerful tool for intellectual growth and lifelong learning.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Должны ли люди быть вегетарианцами?». Приведите аргументы за и против.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Какую роль играют друзья в жизни человека?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как технологии влияют на образование?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Online platforms and digital resources enable students to learn at their own pace and cater to diverse learning styles. Additionally, technology facilitates collaboration and communication among students and educators worldwide. However, the digital divide remains a significant barrier, as not all students have equal access to devices and connectivity. Therefore, while technology offers immense potential, its benefits must be equitably distributed to ensure inclusive education.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно заботиться о ментальном здоровье?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

Neglecting mental health can lead to anxiety, depression, and burnout, impairing daily functioning. Regular self-care practices, such as mindfulness and exercise, can enhance resilience and emotional stability. Additionally, seeking professional help when needed is essential for recovery. Prioritising mental health promotes overall well-being and enables individuals to lead more fulfilling lives.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Как искусство влияет на развитие общества?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.

It gives voice to marginalised groups and can provoke critical dialogue on pressing issues. Moreover, art fosters empathy by allowing individuals to experience perspectives different from their own. It also contributes to economic growth through cultural industries and tourism. Thus, art is not merely a form of entertainment but a vital force in shaping and advancing civilisation.

expert.task_text: Напишите эссе (5–7 предложений) на тему: «Почему важно сохранять историческую память?». Приведите 2–3 аргумента.
